summary: Makes it unlawful for any person to sell, license, or provide to a certain number or more persons a rental pricing algorithm with the intent or reasonable expectation that it be used by a specified number or more persons to set rental terms for residential premises. Makes it unlawful for a person to set or adopt rental terms based on the recommendation of a rental pricing algorithm if the person knows or should know that the rental pricing algorithm processes nonpublic competitor data for certain purposes.

short_name: California S 57 — Electrical Corporations: Data Centers: Report
full_name: California S 57 — Electrical Corporations: Data Centers: Report
summary: Provides that existing law authorizes the commission to fix the rates and charges for every public utility and requires that those rates and charges be just and reasonable. Authorizes the Public Utilities Commission to assess the extent to which electrical corporation costs associated with new loads from data centers result in cost shifts to other electrical corporation customers.

short_name: California S 69 — Artificial Intelligence Program: Attorney General
full_name: California S 69 — Artificial Intelligence Program: Attorney General
summary: Requires the Attorney General to establish and maintain a specified program to build internal expertise in artificial intelligence, including its applications, risks, regulatory implications, and civil rights impacts. Requires, on or before the specified date, and annually thereafter, the Attorney General to submit a public report to the Legislature describing the program, key developments in artificial intelligence law and policy, and recommendations for additional State oversight or safeguards.

short_name: California A 82 — Health Care: Legally Protected Health Care Activity
full_name: California A 82 — Health Care: Legally Protected Health Care Activity
summary: Expands the Address Confidentiality Program to a gender-affirming health care provider, employee or volunteer who faces threats of violence or harassment because of affiliation with a gender-affirming health services facility. Prohibits a person, business or association from soliciting, selling or trading on the internet or social media personal information or images of providers, employees, volunteers or patients with certain intent. Prohibits certain reports of testosterone or mifepristone prescriptions.

short_name: California A 222 — Data Centers: Power Usage Effectiveness: Cost Shifts
full_name: California A 222 — Data Centers: Power Usage Effectiveness: Cost Shifts
summary: Requires the State Energy Resources Conservation and Development Commission to establish a process for the owner of a data center to submit the power usage effectiveness ratio for the data center to the Energy Commission on a biannual basis. Requires the Energy Commission, as part of the 2027 edition of the Integrated Energy Policy Report, to include an assessment of electrical load trends for data centers.

short_name: California S 238 — Workplace Surveillance Tools
full_name: California S 238 — Workplace Surveillance Tools
summary: Requires an employer to annually provide a notice to the Department of Industrial Relations, in the Labor and Workforce Development Agency, of all the workplace surveillance tools the employer is using in the workplace. Requires the notice to include, among other information, the personal information that will be collected from workers and consumers and whether they will have the option of opting out of the collection of personal information.

short_name: California S 241 — Community Colleges: Personnel: Qualifications
full_name: California S 241 — Community Colleges: Personnel: Qualifications
summary: Relates to the California Community Colleges. Requires a community college instructor, librarian, counselor, student personnel worker, supervisor, administrator, chief administrative officer, extended opportunity programs and services worker, disabled students programs and services worker, apprenticeship instructor, or supervisor of health to be a person who meets specified minimum qualifications to serve in that position or the alternative qualifications to serve in that position.

short_name: California S 253 — State Bar of California
full_name: California S 253 — State Bar of California
summary: Requires the California Lawyers Association or the affiliated 501(c)(3) organization to submit an annual report to the Legislature detailing their use of funds and a statement of compliance with the prohibition on creating, operating, or soliciting members for affinity or royalty programs involving similar products or services.

short_name: California S 259 — Fair Online Pricing Act
full_name: California S 259 — Fair Online Pricing Act
summary: Provides that the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 grants to a consumer various rights with respect to personal information that is collected by a business. Provides for the Fair Online Pricing Act. Prohibits, subject to specified exceptions, a price offered to a consumer through the consumer's online device from being generated, in whole or in part, based on certain input data, including the presence or absence of any software on the online device.

short_name: California A 279 — School Libraries: Model Library Standards
full_name: California A 279 — School Libraries: Model Library Standards
summary: Provides that existing law requires the State Board of Education to adopt standards, rules, and regulations for school library services. Requires the Superintendent of Public Instruction to consider recommending revisions to the standards for school library services to the State Board. Requires the Superintendent to convene a group of experts to assist the Superintendent in developing revisions. Requires the Superintendent, in consultation with the Instructional Quality Commission, to hold public hearings.

short_name: California S 295 — California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
full_name: California S 295 — California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
summary: Enacts the California Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025. Prohibits person from distributing or making recommendations based on the use of a pricing algorithm to a specified number or more competitors if the person knows or should know that the pricing algorithm processes competitor data. Establishes an affirmative defense to liability under this prohibition for a person who demonstrates by a preponderance of evidence that they exercised reasonable due diligence.

short_name: California S 366 — Employment: Artificial Intelligence
full_name: California S 366 — Employment: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires the Department of General Services to contract with the University of California, Los Angeles Labor Center to conduct a study evaluating the impact of artificial intelligence on worker well being, job quality, job types, different populations, and State revenues. Requires the department, on or before the specified date, to submit a report of the findings of the study to the Legislature. Repeals these provisions upon submission of that report.

short_name: California S 384 — Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act: Prohibition
full_name: California S 384 — Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act: Prohibition
summary: Provides for the Preventing Algorithmic Price Fixing Act. Prohibits a person from selling, licensing, providing, or price-setting algorithm with the intent or reasonable expectation that it be used by a specified number or more competitors in the same market if the person knows or should know that the algorithm processes nonpublic data to set either a price or supply level of a good or service or a rent or occupancy level of rental property. Provides a user of such algorithm an affirmative defense.

short_name: California A 392 — Pornographic Internet Websites: Consent
full_name: California A 392 — Pornographic Internet Websites: Consent
summary: Requires a person who operates a website to exercise ordinary care and reasonable diligence to ensure that any sexually explicit content uploaded to the operator's pornographic internet website does not include a depicted individual. Requires an operator of a pornographic website to verify a user's email address before permitting the user to upload sexually explicit content to the operator's website. Authorizes a depicted individual and a public prosecutor to bring a civil action to enforce such provisions.

short_name: California A 410 — Bots: Disclosure
full_name: California A 410 — Bots: Disclosure
summary: Requires a person who uses a bot to autonomously communicate with another to ensure that the bot discloses to any person with whom the bot communicates when the bot first communicates with the person that the bot is a bot and not a human being. Authorizes the Attorney General, a district attorney, a county counsel, a city attorney, or a city prosecutor to bring a civil action to punish noncompliance.

short_name: California A 412 — Generative Artificial Intelligence: Training Data
full_name: California A 412 — Generative Artificial Intelligence: Training Data
summary: Relates to copyrighted materials. Requires a developer of a generative artificial intelligence model to document any covered materials that the developer knows were used by the developer to train the model. Requires the developer to make available a mechanism on the developer's website allowing a rights owner to submit a request for information. Authorizes a rights owner who complies with specified requirements for submitting a request that is not provided with information to bring a civil action.

short_name: California S 420 — Automated Decision Systems
full_name: California S 420 — Automated Decision Systems
summary: Requires a developer or a deployer of a high-risk automated decision system to perform an impact assessment before making it publicly available or deploying it. Authorizes the Attorney General or the Civil Rights Department to allow a developer or deployer to cure certain violations. Prohibits an agency from awarding a contract for a high-risk automated decision system unless the person to whom the contract is awarded has certified that the system does not violate, among other civil rights laws, this bill.

short_name: California S 430 — State Government: Efficiency of Public Sector
full_name: California S 430 — State Government: Efficiency of Public Sector
summary: States the intent of the Legislature to enact legislation that would lessen the time, effort, money, and programmatic expertise of local public sector workers in compliance with state reporting and permit processing, as specified.

short_name: California S 468 — High-risk Artificial Intelligence Systems
full_name: California S 468 — High-risk Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: Imposes a duty on a covered deployer, defined as a business that deploys a high-risk artificial intelligence system that processes personal information, to protect personal information held by the covered deployer, subject to certain requirements.

short_name: California A 502 — Elections: Deceptive Media In Advertisements
full_name: California A 502 — Elections: Deceptive Media In Advertisements
summary: Sets forth additional requirements relating to the color and font size of the disclosure's text. Exempts an election communication from the prohibition if the content includes a disclosure stating that the communication has been generated or substantially altered using artificial intelligence. Exempts an advertisement or other election communication from these prohibitions if a reasonable person would understand that the content was satire or parody.

short_name: California S 503 — Health Care Services: Artificial Intelligence
full_name: California S 503 — Health Care Services: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Specifies that the Department of Public Health is not required to independently inspect, test, or evaluate the functionality of an artificial intelligence system. Requires, beginning January 1, 2027, developers to provide a report identifying compliance efforts with the specified provisions to the department before making an artificial intelligence system commercially or publicly available to a deployer.

short_name: California A 512 — Health Care Coverage: Prior Authorization
full_name: California A 512 — Health Care Coverage: Prior Authorization
summary: Provides for the Medi-Cal program, administered by the State Department of Health Care Services and under which qualified low-income individuals receive health care services, including pursuant to contracts with various types of managed care plans. Authorizes a health care service plan, including a Medi-Cal managed care plan, or disability insurer to use utilization review, under which a licensed physician or a licensed health care professional who is competent to evaluate specific clinical issues.

short_name: California S 524 — Law Enforcement Agencies: Artificial Intelligence
full_name: California S 524 — Law Enforcement Agencies: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires each law enforcement agency to maintain a policy to require an official report prepared by a law enforcement officer or any member of a law enforcement agency that is generated using artificial intelligence either fully or partially to include specified information, including a disclosure statement and the signature of the law enforcement officer or member of a law enforcement agency who prepared the official report. Requires an agency utilizing artificial intelligence to generate a first draft.

short_name: California S 579 — Mental Health and Artificial Intelligence
full_name: California S 579 — Mental Health and Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires the Secretary of Government Operations to appoint a mental health and artificial intelligence working group that would evaluate certain issues to determine the role of artificial intelligence in mental health settings. Requires the working group to take input from various stakeholder groups, including health organizations and academic institutions, and conduct at least a specified number of public meetings.

short_name: California A 621 — Deepfake Pornography
full_name: California A 621 — Deepfake Pornography
summary: Provides that existing law grants to a depicted individual a cause of action against a person who creates and intentionally discloses sexually explicit material. Grants to a depicted individual a cause of action against a person who knows, or reasonably should know, that the depicted individual was a minor when the digitized sexually explicit material was created. Grants a cause of action to that depicted individual against a person who knowingly facilitates or recklessly aids or abets prohibited conduct.

short_name: California A 682 — Health Care Coverage Reporting
full_name: California A 682 — Health Care Coverage Reporting
summary: Requires a health care service plan or health insurer that imposes prior authorization to report specified prior authorization data from the previous calendar year on its internet website on or before February 1, 2026, for health care service plans, on or before February 1, 2028, for health insurers, and annually on or before February 1 thereafter. Requires a health care service plan or health insurer to annually report specified claims and prior authorization data to the relevant department.

short_name: California S 683 — Privacy: Use of a Person's Name
full_name: California S 683 — Privacy: Use of a Person's Name
summary: Provides that a party seeking relief may also seek an injunction or temporary restraining order according to specified procedures. Requires the respondent to comply with the order within 2 business days from the day the order is served, unless otherwise required by the order, if the court grants the applicant a temporary restraining order without notice to the opposing party that requires the respondent to remove, recall, or otherwise cease the publication.

short_name: California A 723 — Real Estate: Digitally Altered Images: Disclosure
full_name: California A 723 — Real Estate: Digitally Altered Images: Disclosure
summary: Requires a real estate broker or salesperson, or person acting on their behalf, who includes a digitally altered image in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale of real property to include a specified disclosure. Requires, if the advertisement or promotional material is posted on an internet website, the same image without digital alteration to be included.

short_name: California S 771 — Personal Rights: Liability: Social Media Platforms
full_name: California S 771 — Personal Rights: Liability: Social Media Platforms
summary: Provides that existing law prohibits a person from using violence or intimidation to interfere with another person's enjoyment of certain rights or because of certain attributes of that person. Makes a social media platform that violates the provisions of law relating to personal rights through its algorithms that relay content to users or aids, abets, acts in concert, or conspires in violation of those laws, liable for specified civil penalties. Provides that such provisions are severable.

short_name: California S 813 — Multistakeholder Regulatory Organizations
full_name: California S 813 — Multistakeholder Regulatory Organizations
summary: Provides that existing law requires the Department of Technology to conduct a comprehensive inventory of all high risk automated decision systems that have been proposed for use, development or procurement by, or are being used, developed, or procured by, a State agency. Establishes a process by which the Attorney General designates a private entity as a multistakeholder regulatory organization. Authorizes the Attorney General to establish a fee structure for charging fees to applicants and designated MROs.

short_name: California S 833 — Critical Infrastructure: Automated Decision Systems
full_name: California S 833 — Critical Infrastructure: Automated Decision Systems
summary: Provides that existing law requires the Technology Recovery Plan element of the State Administrative Manual to ensure the inclusion of cybersecurity strategy incident response standards. Requires an operator responsible for operating, managing, overseeing, or controlling access to critical infrastructure, that deploys a covered artificial intelligence (AI) system to establish a human oversight mechanism that ensures a human monitors the system's operations in real time.

short_name: California A 887 — Pupil Instruction: High Schools: Computer Science
full_name: California A 887 — Pupil Instruction: High Schools: Computer Science
summary: Establishes the California Computer Science Demonstration Grant Program for specified purposes, including increasing the number of public high schools offering a computer science course to increase pupil access to computer science education and increasing the computer science course access of pupils eligible for free or reduced-priced meals and pupils that are underrepresented in the field of computer science.

short_name: California A 979 — California Cybersecurity Integration Center: AI
full_name: California A 979 — California Cybersecurity Integration Center: AI
summary: Requires the State Cybersecurity Integration Center to develop, in consultation with the Office of Information Security and the Government Operations Agency, a State AI Cybersecurity Collaboration Playbook to facilitate information sharing across the cyber and artificial intelligence communities and to strengthen collective cyber defenses against emerging threats. Requires the center to review federal requirements, standards, and industry best practices, and to use those resources to inform the playbook.

short_name: California A 1018 — Automated Decision Systems
full_name: California A 1018 — Automated Decision Systems
summary: Requires a deployer of a covered automated decision system to take certain actions, including conduct impact assessments of the covered ADS and provide deployers to whom the developer transfers the covered ADS with certain information, including a high-level summary of the results of those impact assessments.

short_name: California A 1024 — Dept. of Fish and Wildlife: San Gabriel Valley
full_name: California A 1024 — Dept. of Fish and Wildlife: San Gabriel Valley
summary: Establishes the San Gabriel Valley Bear Management and Community Safety Act, which would require, on or before January 1, 2027, the Department of Fish and Wildlife to develop a regional plan specific to the cities located within the San Gabriel Valley in the County of Los Angeles to address issues relating to bears in the community. Requires the plan to include various components, including, among other things, an overview of the behaviors of the bears in the San Gabriel Mountains.

short_name: California A 1064 — Leading Ethical AI Development (LEAD) for Kids Act
full_name: California A 1064 — Leading Ethical AI Development (LEAD) for Kids Act
summary: Provides for the Leading Ethical AI Development for Kids Act. Prohibits a person, partnership, corporation, business entity, or state or local government agency that makes a companion chatbot available to users from making a companion chatbot available to a child unless the companion chatbot is not foreseeably capable of doing certain things that could harm a child, including encouraging the child to engage in self-harm, suicidal ideation, violence, consumption of drugs or alcohol, or disordered eating.

short_name: California A 1137 — Reporting Mechanism: Child Sexual Abuse Material
full_name: California A 1137 — Reporting Mechanism: Child Sexual Abuse Material
summary: Provides that existing law requires a social media platform to take certain actions with respect to child sexual abuse material on the social media platform, including by requiring the platform to provide a means for a user who is a State resident to report material. Requires a social media company to ensure review by a natural person if there is not an established or known hash match to child sexual abuse material with respect to the reported material and the reported material is not otherwise blocked.

short_name: California A 1159 — Student Personal Information
full_name: California A 1159 — Student Personal Information
summary: Applies the provisions of the K-12 Pupil Online Personal Information Protection Act and the Early Learning Personal Information Protection Act to an operator of a website, online service, online application, or mobile application with actual knowledge that the site, service, or application is used for the applicable school purposes and was designed or marketed for those purposes. Enacts the Higher Education Student Information Protection Act. Authorizes a harmed student or pupil to bring a civil action.

short_name: California A 1242 — Language Access
full_name: California A 1242 — Language Access
summary: Relates to the Dymally-Alatorre Bilingual Services Act. Revises the definition of substantial number of non-English-speaking people to include the higher of either the people served by or eligible to be served by a State agency. Requires the State Health and Human Services Agency to designate a Language Access Director to ensure individuals with limited English proficiency and individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing have meaningful access to government programs and services.

short_name: California A 1331 — Workplace Surveillance
full_name: California A 1331 — Workplace Surveillance
summary: Limits the use of workplace surveillance tools by employers, including by prohibiting an employer from monitoring or surveilling workers in employee-only, employer-designated areas. Provides workers with the right to leave behind workplace surveillance tools that are on their person or in their possession during off-duty hours. Prohibits a worker from removing or physically tampering with any component of a workplace surveillance tool that is part of or embedded in employer equipment or vehicles.

short_name: California A 1337 — Information Practices Act of 1977
full_name: California A 1337 — Information Practices Act of 1977
summary: Provides that the Information Practices Act of 1977 prescribes a set of requirements, prohibitions, and remedies applicable to agencies with regard to their collection, storage, and disclosure of personal information. Prohibits an agency from using records containing personal information for any purpose or purposes other than the purpose or purposes for which that personal information was collected, except as required or authorized by State law.

short_name: California A 1405 — Artificial Intelligence: Auditors: Enrollment
full_name: California A 1405 — Artificial Intelligence: Auditors: Enrollment
summary: Requires the Government Operations Agency to establish a mechanism on the agency's website allowing artificial intelligence auditors to enroll with the agency and allowing natural persons to report misconduct by an enrolled AI auditor. Requires the agency to publish information provided by an enrolled AI auditor on the agency's website, retain specified reports, and share reports submitted by persons reporting misconduct with other State agencies. Requires an AI auditor to enroll with the agency.

short_name: Colorado H 1030 — Data Center and Utility Modernization
full_name: Colorado H 1030 — Data Center and Utility Modernization
summary: Concerns facilitation of data center development while supporting utility resources, creates the State data center workforce, clean energy, grid modernization, and consumer and environmental protection act.

short_name: Colorado H 1049 — Prohibit Use of Personally Identifying Feature
full_name: Colorado H 1049 — Prohibit Use of Personally Identifying Feature
summary: Concerns prohibiting the use of another individual's personally identifying feature without permission.

short_name: Colorado H 1139 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in Health Care
full_name: Colorado H 1139 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in Health Care
summary: Requires entities that use an artificial intelligence system or algorithm for utilization review to ensure that the system complies with certain requirements, relates to the unauthorized practice of psychotherapy, requires disclosure of a clients right to consent to a disclosure of confidential communications, prohibits a health insurance carrier and a payer of services under the Medical Assistance Act and the Childrens Basic Health Plan Act from paying for psychotherapy services conducted by an AI system.

short_name: Colorado H 1195 — Psychotherapy Artificial Intelligence Restrictions
full_name: Colorado H 1195 — Psychotherapy Artificial Intelligence Restrictions
summary: Prohibits psychologists, professional counselors, social workers, clinical social workers, marriage and family therapists, addiction counselors, unlicensed psychotherapists and other individuals lawfully permitted to provide psychotherapy services in the State from using an artificial intelligence system to directly interact with clients in any form of therapeutic communication, generate therapeutic recommendations or treatment plans without review by regulated professionals, or to detect mental states.

short_name: Colorado H 1210 — Unfair or Deceptive Trade Practices
full_name: Colorado H 1210 — Unfair or Deceptive Trade Practices
summary: Prohibits discrimination against a consumer or worker through the use of automated decision systems used to engage in individualized price setting based on surveillance data regarding a consumer, prohibits individualized wage setting based on such data regarding a worker, specifies activities that are not prohibited as individualized price or wage setting based on surveillance data regarding a consumer or worker, provides that the Attorney General or a district attorney may bring certain civil actions.

short_name: Colorado H 1263 — Conversational Artificial Intelligence Service Operator
full_name: Colorado H 1263 — Conversational Artificial Intelligence Service Operator
summary: Concerns requirements for an operator of a conversational artificial intelligence service, defines a conversational artificial intelligence service as an artificial intelligence system that is accessible to the general public and that primarily simulates human conversation and interaction through textual, visual, or aural communications.

short_name: Colorado S 4 — Increase Transparency for Algorithmic Systems
full_name: Colorado S 4 — Increase Transparency for Algorithmic Systems
summary: Concerns measures effective no later than June 30, 2026, to increase transparency for algorithmic systems.

short_name: Colorado S 8 — Tech Neutral Anti Discrimination Clarification Act
full_name: Colorado S 8 — Tech Neutral Anti Discrimination Clarification Act
summary: Concerns clarifying anti-discrimination protections in interactions with artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Colorado S 11 — Detection Components for Wildfire Mitigation
full_name: Colorado S 11 — Detection Components for Wildfire Mitigation
summary: Requires the division of fire prevention and control in the Department of Public Safety to establish public-private agreements with one or more private partners, by which agreements the state may allocate responsibility or risk to one or more private partners to develop and operate wildfire detection components.

short_name: Colorado S 22 — Applying Artificial Intelligence to Fight Wildfire
full_name: Colorado S 22 — Applying Artificial Intelligence to Fight Wildfire
summary: Concerns the application of artificial intelligence, predicts, prevents, or assists in fighting wildfires, makes an appropriation.

short_name: Colorado S 86 — Protections for Users of Social Media
full_name: Colorado S 86 — Protections for Users of Social Media
summary: Concerns protections for users of social media, and, in connection therewith, establishing certain requirements for social media companies, provides that general assembly finds that self-regulation by social media companies has not worked, and it is time for the State to step in and put common-sense laws in place to protect its youth, directs social media companies to provide annual data about minors' use of social media platforms, including metrics concerning criminal activity.

short_name: Colorado S 143 — Extend Prohibition on School Facial Recognition
full_name: Colorado S 143 — Extend Prohibition on School Facial Recognition
summary: Concerns the limited use of facial recognition services by schools, provides that for a product, device, or software application that allows for analysis of facial features for educational purposes in conjunction with curricula, allows for the analysis of facial features to identify a person who has made a significant threat against a school or the occupants of a school, or to identify a missing student.

short_name: Colorado S 280 — Data Center Development and Grid Modernization Act
full_name: Colorado S 280 — Data Center Development and Grid Modernization Act
summary: Concerns benefits to facilitate data center development while supporting electric grid infrastructure, creates the State data center development and grid modernization act.

short_name: Colorado S 318 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protections
full_name: Colorado S 318 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protections
summary: Concerns consumer protections in interactions with artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Colorado H 1004 — Pricing Coordination Between Landlords
full_name: Colorado H 1004 — Pricing Coordination Between Landlords
summary: Prohibits a landlord from subscribing to, contracting with, or exchanging any form of consideration in return for the services of a coordinator, prohibits a coordinator from facilitating an agreement among landlords that restricts competition, prohibits two or more landlords from engaging in consciously parallel pricing coordination, provides that a violation is punishable in accordance with the State Antitrust Act of 2023, requires the Division of Housing to develop a public education program.

short_name: Colorado H 1008 — Consumer Protections and Artificial Intelligence System
full_name: Colorado H 1008 — Consumer Protections and Artificial Intelligence System
summary: Concerns implementing consumer protections in interactions with artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Colorado H 1009 — Artificial Intelligence Systems
full_name: Colorado H 1009 — Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: Concerns artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Colorado H 1212 — Public Safety Protections Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Colorado H 1212 — Public Safety Protections Artificial Intelligence
summary: Concerns public safety protection from the risks of artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Colorado H 1264 — Prohibits Intimate Personal Data Automated Analysis
full_name: Colorado H 1264 — Prohibits Intimate Personal Data Automated Analysis
summary: Concerns limiting the use of automated analysis of intimate personal data to make inferences that impact a person's financial position.

short_name: Colorado H 1287 — Social Media Tools for Minor Users Parents
full_name: Colorado H 1287 — Social Media Tools for Minor Users Parents
summary: Concerns tools to protect minor users of social media.

short_name: Connecticut S 4 — Consumer Privacy
full_name: Connecticut S 4 — Consumer Privacy
summary: Concerns consumer privacy and protection, requires the controller to perform its responsibility to respond to a consumer's rights when the controller processes that consumer's personal data by automated means, applies when such data is used for profiling to make a solely automated decision that results in either providing or denying an employment opportunity, prohibits controller to sell, share or transfer, or allow any other person to access, precise geolocation data.

short_name: Connecticut S 5 — Online Safety
full_name: Connecticut S 5 — Online Safety
summary: Concerns online safety, establishes various requirements concerning artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence systems, artificial intelligence technologies, artificial intelligence companions and automated employment-related decision processes and an Artificial Intelligence Policy Office to be overseen by an Artificial Intelligence Policy Director, requires subscription-based artificial intelligence providers to make consumer disclosure.

short_name: Connecticut S 86 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Connecticut S 86 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Addresses innovations in and the responsible use of artificial intelligence.

short_name: Connecticut S 292 — Definition of Child Sexual Abuse Material
full_name: Connecticut S 292 — Definition of Child Sexual Abuse Material
summary: Concerns the definition of child sexual abuse material, expands the definition of child sexual abuse material, provides for the definition of a visual depiction of a subject when described as indistinguishable, excludes the definition to a visual depiction that is a drawing, cartoon, sculpture or painting of a person under sixteen years of age.

short_name: Connecticut S 325 — Disclosure of the Residential Address of Public School
full_name: Connecticut S 325 — Disclosure of the Residential Address of Public School
summary: Prohibits the disclosure of the residential address of public school employees under the freedom of information act, establishes a task force concerning mass requests under the act.

short_name: Connecticut S 342 — Health Coverage
full_name: Connecticut S 342 — Health Coverage
summary: Requires health carriers and preferred provider networks that contract with providers to pay equal reimbursement rates for certain outpatient services to all providers in a geographic area, clarifies that health carriers and health plan administrators may use certain utilization management tools, relates to anti steering clauses, prohibits insurers from requiring step therapy for prescription drugs used to treat all forms of cancer and certain diseases, relates to algorithmic or automatic claim downcoding.

short_name: Connecticut S 417 — Department of Economic and Community Development
full_name: Connecticut S 417 — Department of Economic and Community Development
summary: Requires the Department of Economic and Community Development to develop a plan to establish an artificial intelligence small business program, incentivizes small businesses to adopt and deploy artificial intelligence for purposes of achieving improvements in productivity and the quality of any products or services offered by such small businesses, establishes a competitive small business environment for the development and deployment of artificial intelligence technologies.

short_name: Connecticut S 435 — Automated Decision Systems Protections for Employees
full_name: Connecticut S 435 — Automated Decision Systems Protections for Employees
summary: Concerns automated decision systems protections for employees, relates to developer of an automated employment-related decision process that is deployed in the state shall provide to the deployer of such automated employment-related decision process all information that such deployer requires to perform such deployer's duties.

short_name: Connecticut S 483 — Crime of Digital Forgery
full_name: Connecticut S 483 — Crime of Digital Forgery
summary: Establishes the crime of digital forgery, provides that a person is guilty of digital forgery when such person, with intent to cause financial injury to another person, creates and disseminates a visual representation or audio recording that such person knows or should have known is a digitally forged likeness.

short_name: Connecticut S 515 — Connecticut Workforce and a Productivity Gap Surcharge
full_name: Connecticut S 515 — Connecticut Workforce and a Productivity Gap Surcharge
summary: Concerns the State workforce and a productivity gap surcharge, relates to an augmented productivity tax exemption that ensures that any augmented productivity achieved by an employer is permanently exempt from taxation by the state.

short_name: Connecticut H 5003 — Workforce Development and Working Conditions
full_name: Connecticut H 5003 — Workforce Development and Working Conditions
summary: Concerns workforce development and working conditions in the state, increases workforce development efforts and improve working conditions in the state.

short_name: Connecticut H 5125 — Entertainment Event Tickets
full_name: Connecticut H 5125 — Entertainment Event Tickets
summary: Concerns entertainment event tickets, specifies the circumstances in which a ticket reseller may enter into a contract with, or accept consideration from, a purchaser for the resale of a ticket to an entertainment event, establishes and modifies various requirements concerning the sale or resale of a ticket to an entertainment event by way of an Internet website or online technology platform, defines various terms concerning tickets to entertainment events.

short_name: Connecticut H 5229 — Gaming
full_name: Connecticut H 5229 — Gaming

short_name: Georgia S 444 — Private Review Agents
full_name: Georgia S 444 — Private Review Agents
summary: Relates to certification of private review agents, so as to provide that certain decisions with regard to the provision of insurance coverage for healthcare services shall not be based solely on artificial intelligence systems, artificial intelligence, or other software tools, provides for definitions, provides for related matters, provides for an effective date, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 455 — Artificial Intelligence Commission
full_name: Georgia S 455 — Artificial Intelligence Commission
summary: Relates to commissions and other agencies, so as to provide for the establishment of the Georgia Artificial Intelligence Commission, provides for responsibilities, provides for purpose, provides for assignment to the Georgia Technology Authority, provides for annual reports, provides for membership, terms, meetings, and compensation, provides for definitions, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 488 — General Provisions Relative to Torts
full_name: Georgia S 488 — General Provisions Relative to Torts
summary: Relates to general provisions relative to torts, so as to provide that generative artificial intelligence systems shall constitute personal property for purposes of certain actions for product liability alleging injury to a minor, provides for liability of product sellers in such actions, establishes rebuttable presumptions relative to manufacturers and product sellers in such actions, provides for definitions, provides for an effective date and applicability, provides for related matters.

short_name: Georgia S 505 — Prior Approval for Consumer Insurance Rates Act
full_name: Georgia S 505 — Prior Approval for Consumer Insurance Rates Act
summary: Relates to regulation of rates, underwrits rules, and related organizations, so as to require that private passenger motor vehicle and residential property insurance premium rates must be approved by the Commissioner prior to use, provides for related matters, provides for a short title, provides for an effective date and applicability, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 540 — Online Internet Safety
full_name: Georgia S 540 — Online Internet Safety
summary: Relates to online internet safety, requires certain disclosures related to AI companion chatbots, requires the operators of AI companion chatbots to perform age verification in certain circumstances, provides for AI companion chatbots operated by licensed mental health, behavioral health, medical, or counseling professionals, provides for certain privacy tools, requires operators to adopt a protocol for an AI companion chatbot's response to suicidal ideation or self-harm.

short_name: Georgia S 559 — Fair Business Practices Act
full_name: Georgia S 559 — Fair Business Practices Act
summary: Relates to the Fair Business Practices Act of 1975, so as to prohibit any person from facilitating noncompete agreements between residential rental property owners or managers, including by use of algorithmic coordinating functions, prohibits rental property owners or managers from setting or adjusting rental prices, lease renewal terms, occupancy levels, or other lease terms and conditions based on recommendations from software, data analytics service, or algorithmic devices.

short_name: Georgia H 566 — NO FAKES Act
full_name: Georgia H 566 — NO FAKES Act
summary: Relating to selling and other trade practices, so as to enact the NO FAKES Act of 2026, protects intellectual property rights in the voice and visual likeness of individuals, provides for the characteristics of a right to use the voice or visual likeness in a digital replica, provides for licensing and transferability of a right, requires the Secretary of State to maintain a directory of certain post-mortem digital replication rights and a directory of designated agents.

short_name: Georgia H 1034 — Tech Support Impersonation and Remote Access Protection
full_name: Georgia H 1034 — Tech Support Impersonation and Remote Access Protection
summary: Relates to financial institutions, so as to require that financial institutions provide customers the ability to place emergency holds on suspected fraudulent transactions, relates to selling and other trade practices, relates to forgery and fraudulent practices.

short_name: Georgia H 1114 — Quality Basic Education Act
full_name: Georgia H 1114 — Quality Basic Education Act
summary: Relates to competencies and core curriculum under the Quality Basic Education Act, provides for minimum content standards for digital literacy instruction, requires students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to receive grade level appropriate instruction in digital literacy, requires the Department of Education to develop and publish model programs, publishes an annual report assessing the reach and impact of online safety education efforts.

short_name: Georgia H 1269 — Quality Basic Education Act
full_name: Georgia H 1269 — Quality Basic Education Act
summary: Relates to competencies and core curriculum under the Quality Basic Education Act, provides for content standards for digital literacy instruction, requires students in kindergarten through twelfth grade to receive grade level appropriate instruction in digital literacy, requires the Department of Education to develop and publish model programs, publishes an annual report assessing the reach and impact of online safety education efforts, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 1351 — State Government
full_name: Georgia H 1351 — State Government
summary: Relates to general provisions of state government, so as to require state agencies to provide a notice to employees when using artificial intelligence in personnel matters, requires a governmental agency to issue a disclaimer regarding the use of artificial intelligence, provides for definitions, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 1399 — Likeness
full_name: Georgia H 1399 — Likeness
summary: Relates to selling and other trade practices, so as to enact the Georgia Likeness, Expression, Generative AI, and Commercial Yield (LEGACY) Act, provides for property rights in an individuals likeness, requires consent for use of an individuals likeness, provides for violations, provides for a private right of action, provides for definitions, provides for related matters, provides for legislative findings, provides an effective date, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 1439 — Surveillance Pricing Act
full_name: Georgia H 1439 — Surveillance Pricing Act
summary: Relates to the Fair Business Practices Act of 1975, so as to prohibit the use of surveillance pricing in retail food establishments subject to certain exceptions, provides for limits on the use of electronic shelf labels, provides for enforcement and penalties, provides for definitions, provides for statutory construction, provides for a short title, provides for legislative findings, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 1520 — Rental Pricing Integrity Act
full_name: Georgia H 1520 — Rental Pricing Integrity Act
summary: Relates to the Fair Business Practices Act of 1975, prohibits certain practices by landlords and coordinators involving the use of nonpublic competitor data to influence rental price and occupancy decisions, provides for annual certification and record retention, provides for enforcement, provides for a short title, provides for legislative findings and intent, provides for an effective date and applicability, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 1603 — Entertainment Artificial Intelligence Accountability
full_name: Georgia H 1603 — Entertainment Artificial Intelligence Accountability
summary: Relates to selling and other trade practices, so as to enact the Georgia Entertainment Artificial Intelligence Accountability and Performer Protection Act, requires consent for use of a performers likeness in a digital replica, provides for violations, provides for a private right of action, provides for definitions, provides for related matters, provides for legislative findings, provides an effective date, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 9 — Election Interference
full_name: Georgia S 9 — Election Interference
summary: Establishes the criminal offenses of fraudulent election interference and solicitation of such, provides for exceptions, provides for the Attorney General to have concurrent jurisdiction over such crimes, provides for punishment, provides for injunctive relief, provides for the State Election Board to publish results of investigations into such offenses, provides for certain disclaimers on campaign advertisements that use AI generated media, provide for the form of such disclaimers.

short_name: Georgia S 37 — AI Accountability Act
full_name: Georgia S 37 — AI Accountability Act
summary: Requires that all governmental entities develop and maintain artificial intelligence system usage plans, relates to commissions and other agencies, so as to create the State Board for Artificial Intelligence, provides guidance to governmental entities in their development of artificial intelligence system usage plans, provides for the purpose, membership, and duties of such board.

short_name: Georgia S 104 — State Government
full_name: Georgia S 104 — State Government
summary: Relates to information technology relative to state government, prohibits the use or installation of any artificial intelligence system on state equipment when the company that developed or deployed such artificial intelligence system is associated with the Peoples Republic of China, provides definitions, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 147 — Technology Authority
full_name: Georgia H 147 — Technology Authority
summary: Provides for an annual inventory of artificial intelligence usage by state agencies, provides for annual reports of such, provides for the authority to develop and establish certain policies, designates the Attorney General as an applicable elected representative who may approve the issuance of certain private activity bonds to finance or refinance state charter school facilities, provides for the establishment of procedures for public notices and hearings relative to the issuance of such bonds.

short_name: Georgia S 164 — Trade Practices
full_name: Georgia S 164 — Trade Practices
summary: Relates to selling and other trade practices, so as to prohibit surveillance based price discrimination and surveillance based wage discrimination, provides for definitions, provides for civil penalties and enforcement, provides for exceptions, provides for certain rule making, provides for the promulgation of rules and regulations, provides for penalties, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 167 — Commerce and Trade
full_name: Georgia S 167 — Commerce and Trade
summary: Relates to commerce and trade, so as to provide broadly for private entities that employ certain AI systems to guard against discrimination caused by such systems, provides for a description of consequential decisions for which use of automated decision systems shall be regulated, provides for exemptions, provides for trade secret protections, provides for rule making, provides for certain disclosed records by developers and deployers to be exempt from open records requirements.

short_name: Georgia H 171 — Ensuring Accountability for Illegal AI Activities Act
full_name: Georgia H 171 — Ensuring Accountability for Illegal AI Activities Act
summary: Relates to general provisions relative to obscenity and related offenses, so as to prohibit distribution of computer-generated obscene material depicting a child, provides for a standard for obscenity, provides for a penalty and probation, relates to procedure for sentencing and imposition of punishment, so as to provide for sentencing of defendants who utilize artificial intelligence in the commission of certain offenses, provides for notice and enhanced sentencing.

short_name: Georgia S 249 — Quality Basic Education Act
full_name: Georgia S 249 — Quality Basic Education Act
summary: Relates to competencies and core curriculum under the Quality Basic Education Act, so as to provide that, begins in the specified school year, a computer science course shall be a high school graduation requirement, provides for certain computer science courses to be substituted for units of credit graduation requirements in certain other subject areas, provides for such exception, revises legislative findings, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 318 — Illegal and Void Contracts Generally
full_name: Georgia S 318 — Illegal and Void Contracts Generally
summary: Relates to illegal and void contracts generally, so as to prohibit certain agreements involving parallel pricing coordination as unenforceable contracts in general restraint of trade with respect to residential rental properties, provides for a civil penalty, provides for educational materials informing residents in this state of the provisions of this Act, provides for statutory construction, provides for an effective date and applicability, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia S 354 — Torts
full_name: Georgia S 354 — Torts
summary: Relates to torts, so as to provide for a cause of action for appropriating an individuals indicia of identity, provides for a right to protection against the appropriation of an individuals indicia of identity, provides for assignment or licensing of such right, provides for damages, provides for other remedies, provides for exceptions, provides for definitions, provides for statutory construction, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 478 — Commerce and Trade
full_name: Georgia H 478 — Commerce and Trade
summary: Relates to the Fair Business Practices Act, so as to require that ai generated content used in commerce and trade include a disclaimer indicating such content was generated using artificial intelligence, provides for the form of such disclaimers, provides for a definition, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 487 — Quality Basic Education Act
full_name: Georgia H 487 — Quality Basic Education Act
summary: Relates to competencies and core curriculum under the Quality Basic Education Act, so as to provide that, begins in the 2031-2032 school year, a computer science course shall be a high school graduation requirement, provides for certain computer science courses to be substituted for units of credit graduation requirements in certain other subject areas, provides for such exception, revises legislative findings, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 566 — NO FAKES Act
full_name: Georgia H 566 — NO FAKES Act
summary: Relating to selling and other trade practices, so as to enact the NO FAKES Act of 2025, protects intellectual property rights in the voice and visual likeness of individuals, provides for the characteristics of a right to use the voice or visual likeness in a digital replica, provides for licensing and transferability of a right, requires the Secretary of State to maintain a directory of certain post-mortem digital replication rights and a directory of designated agents.

short_name: Georgia H 679 — End Rental Price Fixing Act
full_name: Georgia H 679 — End Rental Price Fixing Act
summary: Relates to illegal and void contracts generally, so as to prohibit certain agreements involving rental price-fixing as unenforceable contracts in general restraint of trade with respect to residential rental properties, provides for a criminal penalty, provides for statutory construction, provides for a short title, provides for an effective date and applicability, provides for related matters, repeals conflicting laws.

short_name: Georgia H 715 — Fair and Future Ready Housing Act
full_name: Georgia H 715 — Fair and Future Ready Housing Act
summary: Relates to fair housing, so as to provide for artificial intelligence or automated decision tools in actions for discriminatory housing practices, prohibits the use of certain defenses in actions for discriminatory housing practices, prohibits the use of artificial intelligence or automated decision tools without human oversight in making certain housing determinations, prohibits making certain housing determinations using artificial intelligence or automated decision tools without certain disclosures.

short_name: Guam R 127 — Advance Educational Equity and Academic Success
full_name: Guam R 127 — Advance Educational Equity and Academic Success
summary: Empowers the State Department of Education to advance educational equity and academic success by establishing an early childhood literacy and parenting curriculum for pregnant and parenting students, examine the role and develop policies and/or curriculum pertaining to artificial intelligence, and by strengthening supports to mitigate social promotion while ensuring all students meet essential learning standards.

short_name: Guam B 64 — Artificial Intelligence Regulatory Task Force
full_name: Guam B 64 — Artificial Intelligence Regulatory Task Force
summary: Establishes the Guam Artificial Intelligence (AI) Regulatory Task Force to develop a comprehensive framework for the regulation of artificial intelligence (AI) in the Government of Guam and private sector while protecting Constitutional and Organic Act Rights.

short_name: Guam B 171 — Deepfakes
full_name: Guam B 171 — Deepfakes
summary: Prohibits the creation, possession, disclosure, or threatened disclosure of nonconsensual intimate depictions, whether authentic or technologically manipulated (""deepfakes""), provides criminal penalties, civil remedies, forfeiture, victim-privacy safeguards, and expanded jurisdiction.

short_name: Guam B 209 — Generative AI Prohibitions
full_name: Guam B 209 — Generative AI Prohibitions
summary: Prohibits the creation and distribution of materially deceptive media produced by generative artificial intelligence in connection with elections.

short_name: Hawaii H 1598 — University Climate Institute
full_name: Hawaii H 1598 — University Climate Institute
summary: Establishes the Hawaii Climate Institute at the University of Hawaii to support climate resilience and adaptation initiatives of the University and the State, requires a percentage of the revenue generated by any increase to the Transient Accommodations Tax rates beginning on January 1, 2026, and by assessment of the Transient Accommodations Tax on gross rental proceeds derived from cruise fares to be allocated to the University of Hawaii annually to support the programs and operations.

short_name: Hawaii S 1618 — Journalistic Ethics Commission
full_name: Hawaii S 1618 — Journalistic Ethics Commission
summary: Establishes a Journalistic Ethics Commission within the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, establishes a Journalistic Code of Ethics, requires news media outlets to provide training in the ethics of journalism to journalists and editors in their employ, establishes a Journalistic Ethics Review Board to be administratively attached to the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, requires the Journalistic Ethics Review Board to handle complaints and appeals regarding violations.

short_name: Hawaii H 1676 — Artificial Intelligence in Education Task Force
full_name: Hawaii H 1676 — Artificial Intelligence in Education Task Force
summary: Establishes an Artificial Intelligence in Education Task Force to develop guidelines and recommendations for the use of artificial intelligence in state public education, appropriates funds.

short_name: Hawaii H 1681 — Nonconsensual Distribution of Intimate Images
full_name: Hawaii H 1681 — Nonconsensual Distribution of Intimate Images
summary: Establishes the offense of nonconsensual distribution of an intimate image.

short_name: Hawaii H 1682 — Disclosure of Intimate Images
full_name: Hawaii H 1682 — Disclosure of Intimate Images
summary: Enacts the Uniform Civil Remedies for Unauthorized Disclosure of Intimate Images Act.

short_name: Hawaii H 1782 — Artificial Intelligence Services Safeguards
full_name: Hawaii H 1782 — Artificial Intelligence Services Safeguards
summary: Establishes safeguards, protections, oversight, and penalties for interactions between minors and artificial intelligence companion systems or conversational artificial intelligence services.

short_name: Hawaii H 1787 — Health Care Software Restrictions
full_name: Hawaii H 1787 — Health Care Software Restrictions
summary: Establishes restrictions on the use of artificial intelligence, algorithms, or other software tools for purposes of decision making in health insurance utilization reviews, requires a licensed health care provider to review all adverse actions by the health carrier.

short_name: Hawaii H 1887 — Statewide Artificial Intelligence Literacy Curricula
full_name: Hawaii H 1887 — Statewide Artificial Intelligence Literacy Curricula
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop and implement a statewide artificial intelligence literacy curricula plan for students in eleventh and twelfth grades, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year as a condition for graduation, establishes the advisory council for artificial intelligence education, establishes a three year artificial intelligence education grant pilot program within the Department of Education, requires reports to the Legislature, appropriates funds.

short_name: Hawaii H 1954 — Identity Theft By Materially Deceptive Media
full_name: Hawaii H 1954 — Identity Theft By Materially Deceptive Media
summary: Includes fraudulent impersonation or false depiction through artificial intelligence or materially deceptive media in the offenses of identity theft.

short_name: Hawaii H 1963 — Image Based Sexual Abuse
full_name: Hawaii H 1963 — Image Based Sexual Abuse
summary: Establishes the nonconsensual disclosure of intimate or private images as a criminal offense, amends the criteria for an extended term of imprisonment to include an offender whose act of attempting to commit or committing the nonconsensual disclosure of intimate images or private images against a minor or vulnerable adult was the proximate cause of the victim's death.

short_name: Hawaii S 2076 — Artificial Intelligence Deepfakes
full_name: Hawaii S 2076 — Artificial Intelligence Deepfakes
summary: Protects a person's right to publicity from digital replicas by including digital replica in the definition of likeness that is protected under state law that governs publicity rights.

short_name: Hawaii S 2135 — Intimate Image Privacy
full_name: Hawaii S 2135 — Intimate Image Privacy
summary: Establishes the nonconsensual disclosure of intimate images or private images as a criminal offense, amends the criteria for an extended term of imprisonment to include an offender whose act of attempting to commit or committing the nonconsensual disclosure of intimate images or private images against a minor or vulnerable adult was the proximate cause of the victim's death.

short_name: Hawaii H 2136 — Surveillance Data Pricing Practices
full_name: Hawaii H 2136 — Surveillance Data Pricing Practices
summary: Designates pricing practices based on surveillance data as unfair or deceptive acts or practices and unfair methods of competition in the conduct of any trade or commerce.

short_name: Hawaii H 2137 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Hawaii H 2137 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Prohibits certain harmful uses of and mandates disclosure for realistic digital imitations generated by artificial intelligence (AI), establishes certain exemptions, provides for civil actions and civil remedies for individuals injured by unauthorized AI-generated realistic digital imitations, requires the disclosure of the use of synthetic performers in advertising, establishes civil fines.

short_name: Hawaii S 2167 — Patients Bill of Rights
full_name: Hawaii S 2167 — Patients Bill of Rights
summary: Revises the state Patients' Bill of Rights and responsibilities act by establishing new provisions on telehealth parity, prior authorization timelines, and automated decision systems, enhancing medical data protection and privacy standards, expanding the Insurance Commissioner's enforcement authority, and improving network adequacy, internal and external appeals procedures, and reporting requirements.

short_name: Hawaii S 2212 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Education
full_name: Hawaii S 2212 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Education
summary: Requires the Department of Education to develop and implement a statewide artificial intelligence literacy curricula plan for students in eleventh and twelfth grades, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year as a condition for graduation, establishes the advisory council for artificial intelligence education, establishes a three year artificial intelligence education grant pilot program within the Department of Education, requires reports to the Legislature, appropriates funds.

short_name: Hawaii S 2281 — Patient Interactions Artificial Intelligence Use
full_name: Hawaii S 2281 — Patient Interactions Artificial Intelligence Use
summary: Requires health care providers using artificial intelligence (AI) in patient interactions to disclose to the patient that the patient is interacting with artificial intelligence, requires health care providers using ai in making consequential decisions relating to the patient to provide certain notice and statements to the patient, maintains a qualified AI oversight personnel who shall be a natural person that reviews, evaluates, and validates or overrides AI outputs.

short_name: Hawaii S 2304 — Identity Theft
full_name: Hawaii S 2304 — Identity Theft
summary: Includes fraudulent impersonation or false depiction through artificial intelligence or materially deceptive media in the offenses of identity theft.

short_name: Hawaii H 2319 — State Health Planning and Development Agency
full_name: Hawaii H 2319 — State Health Planning and Development Agency
summary: Amends the functions and responsibilities of the State Health Planning and Development Agency, adds a new definition of health care, amends the exemption threshold for bed changes to up to thirty per cent of existing licensed bed types, exempts the Department of Health from certificate of need requirements.

short_name: Hawaii H 2357 — Artificial Intelligence Use
full_name: Hawaii H 2357 — Artificial Intelligence Use
summary: Prohibits music streaming platforms from hosting, distributing, or otherwise making available in the State music performed or attributed to an artificial intelligence music artist, makes violations an unfair method of competition and an unfair and deceptive act or practice.

short_name: Hawaii H 2379 — Insurance Fraud
full_name: Hawaii H 2379 — Insurance Fraud
summary: Increases the scope of insurance fraud and certain offenses, augments offenses by contractors and insurers during a declared emergency, clarifies the penalties for the offense of insurance fraud and the capabilities and operations of the insurance fraud investigations branch, including the annual report to the Legislature and the protection of sensitive information, adds protection for insurance fraud whistleblowers, authorizes the Insurance Commissioner to establish a centralized database.

short_name: Hawaii H 2458 — Retailers Surveillance Pricing
full_name: Hawaii H 2458 — Retailers Surveillance Pricing
summary: Requires the Office of Consumer Protection of the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs to conduct a study to determine the extent to which companies operating in the State deploy surveillance pricing practices, requires a report to the Legislature, appropriates funds.

short_name: Hawaii H 2466 — Schools Phone Use and Social Media Education
full_name: Hawaii H 2466 — Schools Phone Use and Social Media Education
summary: Requires the Department of Education to prohibit electronic telecommunication device usage during the instructional day and implement a social media and artificial intelligence literacy education campaign, creates exemptions for students requiring accommodations, emergency situations, and teacher authorizations, requires the Department of Education to submit a report three years after the initial effective date, and then every five years thereafter.

short_name: Hawaii S 2484 — Climate Resilience and Adaptation Initiatives
full_name: Hawaii S 2484 — Climate Resilience and Adaptation Initiatives
summary: Establishes the Hawaii Climate Institute at the University of Hawaii to support climate resilience and adaptation initiatives of the university and the state, requires six percent of the revenue generated by any increase to the transient accommodations tax rates beginning on January 1, 2026, and by assessment of the transient accommodations tax on gross rental proceeds derived from cruise fares to be allocated to the University of Hawaii annually to support the programs and operations.

short_name: Hawaii H 2499 — Demographic Data
full_name: Hawaii H 2499 — Demographic Data
summary: Requires the Office of Enterprise Technology Services to coordinate the development and maintenance of statewide standards for the collection, management, and reporting of race and ethnicity demographic data by any state or county department, agency, board, or commission, focuses the use of collected demographic data on areas of public interest and establishes transparency and accountability requirements regarding artificial intelligence systems associated with the collected data.

short_name: Hawaii H 2500 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosures
full_name: Hawaii H 2500 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosures
summary: Requires, beginning January 1, 2027, a developer of an algorithmic decision system to provide certain disclosures to a deployer and an individual who is or will be affected by a decision made, informed, or influenced by the algorithmic decision system, provides certain rights and procedures for individual's to access and correct data used by an algorithmic decision system, requires disclosure requirements for generative artificial intelligence systems.

short_name: Hawaii H 2502 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosures
full_name: Hawaii H 2502 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosures
summary: Requires operators of conversational artificial intelligence services in the State to issue certain disclosures to account holders and users, requires operators to develop protocols to respond to prompts or content associated with, and prevent the production of, suicidal ideations in account holders and users, establishes protections for minor account holders of conversational artificial intelligence services, requires operators to submit annual reports to the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs.

short_name: Hawaii H 2537 — Patients Bill of Rights
full_name: Hawaii H 2537 — Patients Bill of Rights
summary: Establishes patient rights with respect to timely access to specialists and referrals and prior authorization determination timelines, establishes certain requirements for health carriers for prior authorization determinations, establishes certain requirements for the use of automated decision support tools for claims determinations and utilization review, requires health carriers to establish certain safeguards for protected health information, establishes certain reporting requirements for network.

short_name: Hawaii S 2578 — Film and Creative Industries Development Special Fund
full_name: Hawaii S 2578 — Film and Creative Industries Development Special Fund
summary: Establishes the Hawaii Film Commission within the Department of Business, Economic Development, and Tourism and transfers the rights, powers, functions, and duties of the Hawaii Film Office to the Commission, requires appointments and hiring of staff by specified date, establishes the Film Industry Development Special Fund. Excludes media and film from the definition of creative industries.

short_name: Hawaii S 2585 — Artificial Intelligence Online Clearinghouse
full_name: Hawaii S 2585 — Artificial Intelligence Online Clearinghouse
summary: Requires the Department of Health, in coordination with the Department of Budget and Finance and Office of Enterprise Technology Services, and Department of Human Services, to establish and maintain an online clearinghouse enhanced by artificial intelligence of evidence based treatment and prevention programs, requires Department of Health to support the integration of artificial intelligence in the online clearinghouse.

short_name: Hawaii H 2591 — State Open Data Portal Website
full_name: Hawaii H 2591 — State Open Data Portal Website
summary: Requires the Chief Data Officer to enhance the state's open data portal website through the phased development and publishing of an artificial intelligence chatbot and necessary data visualizations on statewide shared data sets to assist the public in navigating the open data portal website and finding information about statewide services across state departments and agencies, requires the Chief Data Officer to develop a system to evaluate and select for procurement artificial intelligence governance tool.

short_name: Hawaii H 2597 — State Open Data Portal Website
full_name: Hawaii H 2597 — State Open Data Portal Website
summary: Requires the Chief Data Officer to enhance the state's open data portal website through the phased development and publishing of an artificial intelligence chatbot and necessary data visualizations on statewide shared data sets to assist the public, requires the Chief Data Officer to develop a system to evaluate and select artificial intelligence governance tools for use by state departments and agencies and establish a mechanism for reporting and publication of artificial intelligence use cases.

short_name: Hawaii H 2607 — Artificial Intelligence Deepfakes
full_name: Hawaii H 2607 — Artificial Intelligence Deepfakes
summary: Protects a person's right to publicity from artificial intelligence deepfakes.

short_name: Hawaii H 2611 — Rental Market Algorithmic Price Setting
full_name: Hawaii H 2611 — Rental Market Algorithmic Price Setting
summary: Prohibits the use of algorithmic price setting in the state's rental market, requires the Department of the Attorney General to develop and undertake a public education program regarding the prohibition, establishes fines and penalties.

short_name: Hawaii S 2768 — Artificial Intelligence In Health Care
full_name: Hawaii S 2768 — Artificial Intelligence In Health Care
summary: Establishes restrictions on the use of artificial intelligence, algorithms, or other software tools for purposes of decision making in health insurance utilization reviews, requires a licensed health care provider to review all adverse actions by the health carrier.

short_name: Hawaii S 2788 — Minors Artificial Intelligence Protections
full_name: Hawaii S 2788 — Minors Artificial Intelligence Protections
summary: Establishes safeguards, protections, oversight, and penalties for interactions between minors and artificial intelligence companion systems or conversational artificial intelligence services.

short_name: Hawaii S 2923 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Hawaii S 2923 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Establishes the Office of Artificial Intelligence Safety and Regulation within the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs to regulate the development, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence technologies in the state, prohibits the deployment of artificial intelligence products in the state unless affirmative proof establishing the product's safety is submitted to the office, appropriates funds.

short_name: Hawaii S 2948 — Insurance Fraud
full_name: Hawaii S 2948 — Insurance Fraud
summary: Prohibits certain solicitation and inducement practices relating to insurance claims. broadens the scope of the offense of insurance fraud and the acts that constitute insurance fraud, establishes disaster-related insurance fraud offenses, clarifies the penalties for the offense of insurance fraud and the capabilities and operations of the Insurance Fraud Investigations Branch, including the annual report to the Legislature and the use of fraud analytics.

short_name: Hawaii S 2953 — Artificial Intelligence Protections
full_name: Hawaii S 2953 — Artificial Intelligence Protections
summary: Establishes consumer protections and insurer governance requirements for the use of artificial intelligence systems in certain insurance practices, includes health insurance benefit determinations and residential property underwriting decisions, establishes review, monitoring, recordkeeping, disclosure, rebuttal, and cure requirements for the use of artificial intelligence systems in certain insurance practices, requires the Insurance Commissioner to adopt rules.

short_name: Hawaii S 2967 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protections
full_name: Hawaii S 2967 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protections
summary: Establishes consumer protection requirements for the use of artificial intelligence systems in consumer interactions and consequential decisions, including disclosures, documentation, and a right to correction, appeal, and human review, makes certain violations an unfair or deceptive act or practice, requires risk management and impact assessments for high risk artificial intelligence systems, requires incident reports to the Executive Director of the Office of Consumer Protection and the Attorney General.

short_name: Hawaii S 3001 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Hawaii S 3001 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires operators of conversational artificial intelligence services in the State to issue certain disclosures to account holders and users, requires operators to develop protocols to prevent the production of suicidal ideations in account holders and users. establishes protections for account holders and users of conversational artificial intelligence services. establishes protections for minor account holders and users of conversational artificial intelligence services.

short_name: Hawaii S 3027 — Patients Bill of Rights
full_name: Hawaii S 3027 — Patients Bill of Rights
summary: Establishes patient rights with respect to timely access to specialists and referrals and prior authorization determination timelines, establishes certain requirements for health carriers for prior authorization determinations, establishes certain requirements for the use of automated decision support tools for claims determinations and utilization review, requires health carriers to establish certain safeguards for protected health information, establishes certain reporting requirements.

short_name: Hawaii S 3139 — State Health Planning and Development Agency
full_name: Hawaii S 3139 — State Health Planning and Development Agency
summary: (Governor Bill Package) Amends the functions and responsibilities of the State Health Planning and Development Agency, adds a new definition of ""health care"" for chapter 323D, HRS, amends the exemption threshold for bed changes to up to thirty per cent of existing licensed bed types, exempts the Department of Health from certificate of need requirements.

short_name: Hawaii S 59 — Discriminatory Algorithmic Eligibility Determinations
full_name: Hawaii S 59 — Discriminatory Algorithmic Eligibility Determinations
summary: Prohibits users of algorithmic decision making from utilizing algorithmic eligibility determinations in a discriminatory manner, requires users of algorithmic decision making to send corresponding notices to individual's whose personal information is used, requires users of algorithmic decision making to submit annual reports to the Department of the Attorney General, provides means of civil enforcement.

short_name: Hawaii H 62 — Hospitals and Care Homes Nurse to Patient Ratios
full_name: Hawaii H 62 — Hospitals and Care Homes Nurse to Patient Ratios
summary: Implements various nurse to patient ratios at hospitals and care homes, requires the Department of Health to audit healthcare facility compliance.
