summary: Replaces the term child pornography with the term child sex abuse material throughout the State Code, provides that it is a defense to prosecution of child exploitation and possession of child sex abuse material if a school employee, Department of Child Services employee, or attorney acting in the attorneys capacity as legal counsel immediately notified law enforcement or DCS about the image or matter depicting the sexual conduct and did not duplicate, upload, download, or transfer the image or matter.

short_name: Indiana S 377 — Regional Economic Development
full_name: Indiana S 377 — Regional Economic Development
summary: Relates to regional economic development, provides certain planning and review requirements that must occur before funding may be allotted and disbursed to a state agency for purposes of regional development, specifies priorities for regional development funding commitments, repeals the statute that expires the central Indiana regional development authority.

short_name: Indiana H 1296 — Artificial Intelligence Inventory and Policies
full_name: Indiana H 1296 — Artificial Intelligence Inventory and Policies
summary: Relates to artificial intelligence inventory and policies, requires the Department of Education to establish the following, guidelines and a model policy regarding school artificial intelligence policies, an inventory of artificial intelligence platforms that includes certain information as process and review by which teachers and school administrators may submit an artificial intelligence platform for inclusion on the inventory, requires the department to, conduct a survey of teachers.

short_name: Indiana H 1620 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosure
full_name: Indiana H 1620 — Artificial Intelligence Disclosure
summary: Requires a health care provider to disclose to a patient the provider's use of artificial intelligence technology to, make or inform any decision involved in the provision of health care to the patient, or generate any part of a communication to the patient regarding the patient's health care, requires an insurer that provides accident and sickness coverage to disclose to an insured the insurer's use of artificial intelligence.

short_name: Indiana H 1658 — Phases Out County and Township Assessor Offices
full_name: Indiana H 1658 — Phases Out County and Township Assessor Offices
summary: Eliminates elections for the office of county assessor and township assessor and phases out the offices of county assessor and township assessor as the terms of those elected to the offices expire, transfers the duties of the assessor to the county auditor at the expiration of each assessor's term, requires the department of local government finance (DLGF) to develop an automated valuation model system (AVM system) to be used by the DLGF.

full_name: Iowa HSB 609 — Duties Related to Cyber and Artificial Intelligence

summary: Establishes the Commission to Recommend Methods for Preventing Deed Fraud in the State to study options for both preventing deed fraud and recompensing the victims of deed fraud, provides for membership, provides that the commission shall, among other things, gather information on the practice and prevalence of deed fraud in the State and examine the sufficiency of State laws and practices related to, among other things, criminal penalties and civil remedies available to victims of deed fraud.

short_name: Maine H 153 — Harmful Depictions Generated by Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maine H 153 — Harmful Depictions Generated by Artificial Intelligence
summary: Protects minors from harmful depictions generated by artificial intelligence.

short_name: Maine S 223 — Processes and Fees in the Probate Court System
full_name: Maine S 223 — Processes and Fees in the Probate Court System
summary: Updates processes and fees in the probate court system.

short_name: Maine S 411 — Human Oversight in Medical Insurance Payment Decisions
full_name: Maine S 411 — Human Oversight in Medical Insurance Payment Decisions
summary: Ensures human oversight in medical insurance payment decisions.

short_name: Maine H 411 — Effects of Artificial Intelligence Cellular Telephones
full_name: Maine H 411 — Effects of Artificial Intelligence Cellular Telephones
summary: Studies the effects of artificial intelligence, cellular telephones and social media on public education.

short_name: Maine S 509 — Safety of Nurses and Improve Patient Care
full_name: Maine S 509 — Safety of Nurses and Improve Patient Care
summary: Addresses the safety of nurses and improve patient care by enacting the Maine quality care act.

short_name: Maine S 531 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Denial of Health
full_name: Maine S 531 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Denial of Health
summary: Prohibits the use of artificial intelligence in the denial of health insurance claims.

short_name: Maine H 558 — Illegal Interference by Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maine H 558 — Illegal Interference by Artificial Intelligence
summary: Ensures determinations made by the state are free from unethical, unsafe or illegal interference by artificial intelligence.

short_name: Maine S 636 — Use of Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maine S 636 — Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Prohibits landlords from setting rents through the use of artificial intelligence.

short_name: Maine H 1055 — Use of Dynamic Pricing for Certain Consumer Goods
full_name: Maine H 1055 — Use of Dynamic Pricing for Certain Consumer Goods
summary: Prohibits the use of dynamic pricing for certain consumer goods.

short_name: Maine H 1125 — Artificial Intelligence in Campaign Advertising
full_name: Maine H 1125 — Artificial Intelligence in Campaign Advertising
summary: Regards to artificial intelligence in campaign advertising.

short_name: Maine H 1220 — Maine Online Data Privacy Act
full_name: Maine H 1220 — Maine Online Data Privacy Act
summary: Enacts the State Online Data Privacy Act.

short_name: Maryland S 8 — Artificial Intelligence and Deepfake Representations
full_name: Maryland S 8 — Artificial Intelligence and Deepfake Representations
summary: Prohibits a person from utilizing certain personal identifying information or engaging in certain conduct in order to cause certain harm, prohibits a person from using certain artificial intelligence or certain deepfake representations for certain purposes, provides that a person who is the victim of certain conduct may bring a civil action against a certain person.

short_name: Maryland H 9 — Systems Expansion Program and Oversight Board
full_name: Maryland H 9 — Systems Expansion Program and Oversight Board
summary: Establishes the Maryland 3-1-1 Oversight Board in the Maryland Information Network to oversee the expansion of 3-1-1 systems in the State, establishes the 3-1-1 Program to use certain artificial intelligence to answer certain questions and route certain calls in certain counties, requires the expansion of the 3-1-1 Program to all of the counties in the State after a certain time period.

short_name: Maryland S 114 — 3-1-1 Systems Expansion Program and Oversight
full_name: Maryland S 114 — 3-1-1 Systems Expansion Program and Oversight
summary: Establishes the Maryland 3-1-1 Oversight Board in the Maryland Information Network, establishes the 3-1-1 Program to use certain artificial intelligence to answer certain questions and route certain calls in certain counties, requires creation and implementation of a plan to expand the 3-1-1 Program to all of the counties in Maryland on or before a certain date, establishes the 3-1-1 Technical Advisory Committee.

short_name: Maryland S 141 — Election Misinformation
full_name: Maryland S 141 — Election Misinformation
summary: Requires and authorizes the State Administrator of Elections to take certain actions if the State Administrator receives a credible report that election misinformation or election disinformation has been or is being communicated, disseminated, or distributed, prohibits a person, under certain circumstances, from knowingly or with reckless disregard, creating, using, or disseminating a deepfake to produce materially false information.

short_name: Maryland H 145 — Election Law and Election Misinformation
full_name: Maryland H 145 — Election Law and Election Misinformation
summary: Requires the State Administrator of Elections to take certain actions if the State Administrator receives a credible report that election misinformation or election disinformation, including a deepfake, has been or is being communicated, disseminated, or distributed, requires the Administrator to communication correct information to the public, prohibits a person, under certain circumstances, from knowingly or with reckless disregard using or disseminating a deepfake.

short_name: Maryland H 148 — Surveillance-Based Price and Wage Setting
full_name: Maryland H 148 — Surveillance-Based Price and Wage Setting
summary: Prohibits a person from engaging in certain surveillance-based price setting, makes a certain violation of the Act an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice that is subject to enforcement and penalties under the Maryland Consumer Protection Act, prohibits an employer from engaging in certain surveillance-based wage setting.

short_name: Maryland H 184 — Artificial Intelligence and Deepfake
full_name: Maryland H 184 — Artificial Intelligence and Deepfake
summary: Prohibits a person from utilizing certain personal identifying information or engaging in certain conduct in order to cause physical injury, serious emotional distress, or economic damages, prohibits a person from using certain artificial intelligence or certain deepfake representations for certain purposes, provides penalties of specified years of imprisonment and a fine of specified amount or both where one victim is involved, and for two or more victims the term of imprisonment.

short_name: Maryland H 195 — Studies on the Use of Emerging Technology
full_name: Maryland H 195 — Studies on the Use of Emerging Technology
summary: Requires the State Lottery and Gaming Control Commission to conduct studies of the state lottery and gaming program that identify certain trends and emerging technology to create a safe and transparent gambling environment, requires the commission to analyze certain technology that may be used by the commission to carry out its duties in implementing certain provisions of law concerning sports wagering.

short_name: Maryland S 198 — Aerospace and Aviation Systems Technology Programs
full_name: Maryland S 198 — Aerospace and Aviation Systems Technology Programs
summary: Requires Prince George's Community College, in consultation with certain entities, to complete a certain feasibility study and program design assessment for aerospace and aviation systems technology workforce training programs.

short_name: Maryland S 221 — Child Pornography Prohibition
full_name: Maryland S 221 — Child Pornography Prohibition
summary: Prohibits a person from possessing or viewing certain child pornography under certain circumstances.

short_name: Maryland H 268 — Office of Enterprise Data and State Chief Data Officer
full_name: Maryland H 268 — Office of Enterprise Data and State Chief Data Officer
summary: Establishes the position and responsibilities of the State Chief Data Officer, establishes the Office of Enterprise Data in the Department of Information Technology and the responsibilities of the office.

short_name: Maryland H 314 — Automation Technology Deployment Assessment
full_name: Maryland H 314 — Automation Technology Deployment Assessment
summary: Requires employers with specified number of employees that reduced their workforce in the State by a specified number of employees while using automation technology to submit certain information to the Secretary of Labor concerning the number of employees employed, automation technology deployed or used, and certain employees separated from employment during the immediately preceding calendar year, requires a certain covered employer to pay a certain assessment for each displaced employee.

short_name: Maryland S 375 — Artificial Intelligence Training Program
full_name: Maryland S 375 — Artificial Intelligence Training Program
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to develop or approve an artificial intelligence training program for members of county boards of education that includes foundational training and continuing annual training, requires each member of a county board to complete an artificial intelligence training program each year that covers developments in artificial intelligence technology, evolving best practices for use in education settings and new guidance, provides the training may be in person or online.

short_name: Maryland S 387 — Dynamic Pricing Prohibition
full_name: Maryland S 387 — Dynamic Pricing Prohibition
summary: Prohibits a food retailer from engaging in the practice of dynamic pricing or using consumer surveillance data to set a price for consumer goods or services, prohibits a food retailer from using protected class data to offer, advertise, or sell a consumer good or service under certain circumstances, prohibits a food retailer from diminishing or impairing any right or benefit guaranteed to employees of the food retailer under an existing collective bargaining agreement or memorandum of understanding.

short_name: Maryland H 434 — Use of Algorithmic Device by Landlord
full_name: Maryland H 434 — Use of Algorithmic Device by Landlord
summary: Prohibits a landlord from using certain algorithmic devices to determine the amount of rent to charge for, occupancy levels of, and lease terms and conditions for a residential dwelling unit, makes a violation of the Act an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice under the Maryland Consumer Protection Act, applies the Act prospectively.

short_name: Maryland H 530 — Task Force on Proactive Review of Audio
full_name: Maryland H 530 — Task Force on Proactive Review of Audio
summary: Relates to Task Force on Proactive Review of Audio and Video Recordings on special education buses.

short_name: Maryland S 564 — State Government and Office of the Attorney General
full_name: Maryland S 564 — State Government and Office of the Attorney General
summary: Establishes the Division of Data Protection within the Office of the Attorney General to investigate and bring civil actions related to violations, establishes the Maryland Data Privacy Implementation and Innovation Workgroup to study state's consumer data privacy framework and evaluate implementation issues, requires the Workgroup to report its findings and recommendations to the Governor and the General Assembly by specified date.

short_name: Maryland S 597 — Higher Education Artificial Intelligence Partnership
full_name: Maryland S 597 — Higher Education Artificial Intelligence Partnership
summary: Establishes the State Artificial Intelligence Partnership in the University System of the State to provide a single nexus for certain stakeholders in artificial intelligence initiatives to advance artificial intelligence in the State by carrying out certain duties, establishes the Artificial Intelligence Public Service Fellowship in the University System of the State, establishes, subject to a certain condition, the Artificial Intelligence Incubation Lab in the University System of the State.

short_name: Maryland H 670 — Child Pornography and Prohibitions and Penalties
full_name: Maryland H 670 — Child Pornography and Prohibitions and Penalties
summary: Prohibits a person from possessing more than specified number of images of certain child pornography or possessing or viewing images of certain child pornography depicting a minor or an individual indistinguishable from an actual and identifiable child under the specified age, provides that a violation of the Act is a felony and on conviction a violator is subject to imprisonment not exceeding specified years.

short_name: Maryland S 697 — Actions to Influence an Election
full_name: Maryland S 697 — Actions to Influence an Election
summary: Establishes a rebuttable presumption that a social media platform has made an independent expenditure to a certain candidate if the social media platform knowingly and purposefully alters its algorithm to amplify certain political content for the benefit of the candidate, prohibits a foreign national from using a bot to publish, distribute, or disseminate campaign material or artificially amplify political content to users of an online platform for a certain purpose.

short_name: Maryland H 712 — Product Liability and Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maryland H 712 — Product Liability and Artificial Intelligence
summary: Establishes a cause of action against a developer of a certain artificial intelligence system for defective design, failure to provide adequate instruction or warning, and breach of express warranty, establishes that a deployer of a certain artificial intelligence system may be sued in lieu of a developer under certain circumstances, authorizes the Attorney General to bring an action against a developer or a deployer for harm caused by a certain dangerous or defective product.

short_name: Maryland S 720 — Artificial Intelligence Guidelines
full_name: Maryland S 720 — Artificial Intelligence Guidelines
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to provide certain guidance on artificial intelligence to certain groups through an online platform, requires the Department, in consultation with certain stakeholders, to separately publish certain guidance for certain groups, requires the Department to develop certain strategies to implement certain guidelines and best practices, requires each county board of education to have a certain artificial intelligence policy on or before a certain date.

short_name: Maryland S 736 — Obscene Matter and Visual Representation of Child
full_name: Maryland S 736 — Obscene Matter and Visual Representation of Child
summary: Increases the maximum age of a certain child that may not be depicted in certain visual representations, alters the penalties for knowingly possessing and intentionally retaining, and knowingly or intentionally accessing and intentionally viewing, certain visual representations, authorizes a person depicted in a certain visual representation to bring a certain civil action, requires the Attorney General to submit a certain annual report by specified date.

short_name: Maryland S 770 — Economic Development
full_name: Maryland S 770 — Economic Development
summary: Establishes the Maryland's Future Board under the Department of Commerce to develop, evaluate, and revise a certain visionary plan for the future of Maryland by a certain date and make recommendations for projects based on the plan to the Governor and the General Assembly, establishes the Maryland's Future Fund as a special, non-lapsing fund, requires interest earnings of the Fund to be credited to the Fund.

short_name: Maryland H 795 — AI Health Insurance Accountability Act of 2026
full_name: Maryland H 795 — AI Health Insurance Accountability Act of 2026
summary: Requires that a carrier's internal grievance process provide for human review of grievances results from adverse decisions made using artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tools, requires carriers to report certain information on grievances results from adverse decisions made using artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tools, requires a carrier to provide a model review process under certain circumstances.

short_name: Maryland S 797 — Medical Assistance Program
full_name: Maryland S 797 — Medical Assistance Program
summary: Prohibits insurers, nonprofit health service plans, health maintenance organizations, and managed care organization from downcoding a claim for reimbursement under certain circumstances, establishes certain procedures that insurers, nonprofit health service plans, health maintenance organizations, and managed care organizations are required to follow if the insurer, nonprofit health service plan, or health maintenance organization intends or makes a final decision to downcode a claim.

short_name: Maryland S 826 — Angel Investor Tax Credit for Investments
full_name: Maryland S 826 — Angel Investor Tax Credit for Investments
summary: Allows a credit against the state income tax for specified percent of an investment made in qualified state companies, provides that investments in companies engaging in certain emergent technology may qualify for the tax credit subject to certain requirements, provides that a qualified investor shall make an investment in a qualified state company within a certain amount of time after the Department issues an initial tax credit certificate.

short_name: Maryland S 827 — Consumer Protection and Product Liability
full_name: Maryland S 827 — Consumer Protection and Product Liability
summary: Regulates the manner in which a developer designs and creates and an operator makes available to users in the state a chatbot, including establishing safety and privacy protections for users, establishing an enhanced protection for users who are minors under the specified age, and requiring the display of certain warnings when using a chatbot, establishes that a chatbot is considered a product for certain product liability actions, applies certain provisions of the Act to governmental units.

short_name: Maryland H 883 — Consumer Protection Artificial Intelligence Behavioral
full_name: Maryland H 883 — Consumer Protection Artificial Intelligence Behavioral
summary: Prohibits a developer of artificial intelligence from making, or knowingly causing artificial intelligence to make, certain representations or statements relating to behavioral health care subject to a civil penalty not exceeding specified amount, requires a developer artificial intelligence sold, leased, given, or otherwise provided to consumers in the State to include a certain notice or protocols, authorizes the Attorney General to bring an action for an alleged violation of the Act.

short_name: Maryland S 889 — Electronic Shelving Label
full_name: Maryland S 889 — Electronic Shelving Label
summary: Prohibits a person from engaging in surveillance-based price setting to set the price of consumer goods or services, prohibits a food retailer from using electronic shelving labels to display the prices of consumer goods, and instead requires the use of nondigital presentations of price, makes a certain violation of the act an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice under the Maryland Consumer Protection Act, prohibits an employer from engaging in surveillance-based wage setting.

short_name: Maryland H 924 — Child Exploitation Material
full_name: Maryland H 924 — Child Exploitation Material
summary: Prohibits certain conduct relating to child exploitation material, establishes a civil action for a certain violation of the Act, authorizes the Attorney General to enforce certain provisions of the Act, defines computer-generated image in certain provisions relating to crimes involving child pornography to include an image created through the use of artificial intelligence software, increases the requisite age of a child considered to be a victim of certain child pornography crimes.

short_name: Maryland H 952 — Companion Chatbots and Regulation
full_name: Maryland H 952 — Companion Chatbots and Regulation
summary: Requires certain operators of companion chatbots to establish, maintain, and publish certain protocols and provide certain information to users of the companion chatbot, requires operators to establish enhanced measures for minor users of companion chatbots, requires the Office of Suicide Prevention in the Maryland Department of Health to annually publish certain data compiled from operators, establishes that a violation of the Act is an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice.

short_name: Maryland S 989 — Safe Kids Act
full_name: Maryland S 989 — Safe Kids Act
summary: Prohibits certain conduct relates to child exploitation material, establishes a civil action for a certain violation of the act, authorizes the Attorney General to enforce certain provisions of the act, defines computer-generated image in certain provisions relates to crimes involves child pornography to include an image created through the use of artificial intelligence software, increases the requisite age of a child considered to be a victim of certain child pornography crimes.

short_name: Maryland H 995 — Health Occupations and Behavioral Health Care Providers
full_name: Maryland H 995 — Health Occupations and Behavioral Health Care Providers
summary: Prohibits behavioral health care providers from using artificial intelligence to provide behavioral health care to a patient, authorizes a behavioral health care provider to use a system that employs artificial intelligence in performing administrative support tasks under certain circumstances, requires a behavioral health care provider to obtain certain informed consent from patients if the provider uses a certain system that employs artificial intelligence under certain circumstances.

short_name: Maryland H 1057 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maryland H 1057 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to provide certain guidance on artificial intelligence to local school systems, educators, parents, and student through an online platform, requires the Department to publish certain guidance for certain groups, requires the Department to develop strategies to implement certain guidelines and best practices, requires each county board to designate a coordinator for the use of artificial intelligence in the local school system.

short_name: Maryland H 1085 — Maryland Office of the Inspector General
full_name: Maryland H 1085 — Maryland Office of the Inspector General
summary: Establishes the State Office of the Inspector General, establishes the State Transparency Commission to appoint and provide oversight for the Inspector General of the State, provides for the qualifications, salary, and term of office of the Inspector General, provides for the employment of certain staff by the Inspector General, establishes provisions related to the Powers and duties of the Inspector General, the Chief Deputy Inspector General, and the Office.

short_name: Maryland H 1128 — Angel Investor Tax Credit
full_name: Maryland H 1128 — Angel Investor Tax Credit
summary: Allows a credit against the State income tax for specified percent of an investment made in qualified State companies up to specified amount, provides that investments in companies engaging in certain emergent technology may qualify for the tax credit subject to certain requirements, provides that a qualified investor shall make an investment in a qualified State company within a certain amount of time after the Department issues an initial tax credit certificate.

short_name: Maryland H 1153 — Claims for Reimbursement
full_name: Maryland H 1153 — Claims for Reimbursement
summary: Prohibits insurers, nonprofit health service plans, health maintenance organizations, and managed care organization downcodes a claim for reimbursement under certain circumstances, establishes certain procedures that insurers, nonprofit health service plans, health maintenance organizations, and managed care organizations are required to follow if the insurer, nonprofit health service plan, or health maintenance organization intends or makes a final decision to downcode a claim.

short_name: Maryland H 1250 — Consumer Protection and Product Liability Chatbots
full_name: Maryland H 1250 — Consumer Protection and Product Liability Chatbots
summary: Regulates the manner in which a developer designs and creates and an operator makes available to users in the state a chatbot, including establishing safety and privacy protections for users, establishes, an enhanced protection for users who are minors under the age of 13 years, requires the display of certain warnings when using a chatbot, establishes that a chatbot is considered a product for certain product liability actions, applies certain provisions of the Act to governmental units.

short_name: Maryland H 1261 — Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act
full_name: Maryland H 1261 — Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act
summary: Establishes certain child safety and data privacy requirements for certain toys features artificial intelligence, requires an artificial intelligence toy to contain certain label, prohibits the manufacturer of an artificial intelligence toy from using certain data for certain marketing.

short_name: Maryland H 1294 — Child Sexual Abuse Material
full_name: Maryland H 1294 — Child Sexual Abuse Material
summary: Alters the term child pornography to be child sexual abuse material for purposes of certain criminal offenses, defines computer-generated image to include images created through the use of artificial intelligence software as the term pertains to provisions of law related to child sexual abuse material.

short_name: Maryland H 1385 — Use of Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maryland H 1385 — Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires that certain audits and compliance reviews of an artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tool used for utilization review include a certain evaluation by a licensed health care professional, requires that the review and revision of the performance, use, and outcomes of an artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tool used for utilization review include a certain human evaluation and use of the findings of the evaluation for a certain purpose.

short_name: Maryland H 1399 — Consumer Reporting Agencies
full_name: Maryland H 1399 — Consumer Reporting Agencies
summary: Establishes requirements for consumer reporting agencies that use algorithmic systems to assemble or evaluate consumer credit information on consumers for the purpose of furnishing consumer reports to third parties, requires the Commissioner of Financial Regulation of the Maryland Department of Labor to establish certain assessment thresholds for algorithms, mandate regular training for human reviewers, and implement a certain whistleblower protection program.

short_name: Maryland H 1473 — Economic Development
full_name: Maryland H 1473 — Economic Development
summary: Establishes the Maryland's Future Board under the Department of Commerce to develop, evaluate, and revise a certain visionary plan for the future of Maryland by a certain date and make recommendations for projects based on the plan to the Governor and the General Assembly, establishes the Maryland's Future Fund as a special, nonlapsing fund, requires the Comptroller to study the trends for certain industries and report to the General Assembly on or before a certain date.

short_name: Maryland H 1475 — Dynamic Pricing Disclosure and Prohibition on Rent
full_name: Maryland H 1475 — Dynamic Pricing Disclosure and Prohibition on Rent
summary: Prohibits a merchant from setting the price of consumer goods or services using personalized algorithmic pricing and issuing a certain communication in a certain manner unless the merchant includes a certain disclosure, prohibits a person from knowingly or recklessly operating or licensing in a certain manner to perform a coordinating function to facilitate a certain agreement, prohibits residential rental property owners or managers from knowingly or recklessly setting or adjusting rental terms.

short_name: Maryland H 1563 — Emergency Room Services
full_name: Maryland H 1563 — Emergency Room Services
summary: Authorizes the State Insurance Commissioner to conduct an examination of certain decisions by carriers related to claims or authorization requests for services in, or related to services in, emergency departments, authorizes the Commissioner to have certain decisions independently reviewed under certain circumstances, requires that a certain report required to be compiled by the Commissioner include data on certain adverse decisions and grievances.

short_name: Maryland H 5 — Child Pornography
full_name: Maryland H 5 — Child Pornography
summary: Concerns Criminal Law, relates to child pornography, relates to Artificial Intelligence software.

short_name: Maryland S 361 — Fraudulent Vote Influencing
full_name: Maryland S 361 — Fraudulent Vote Influencing
summary: Prohibits a person from using fraud, influences or attempts to influence a voter's voting decision, provides that fraud, includes the use of synthetic media.

short_name: Maryland S 362 — Forged Digital Likenesses
full_name: Maryland S 362 — Forged Digital Likenesses
summary: Provides that the distribution of a certain forged digital likeness to another, constitutes a statement or communication for the purpose of an action for defamation, prohibits a person from knowingly distributing a certain forged digital likeness under certain circumstances, provides that a person, violates the Act is guilty of a misdemeanor and on conviction is subject to a term of imprisonment of up to three years or a fine of up to a specified amount or both.

short_name: Maryland H 364 — Child Pornography
full_name: Maryland H 364 — Child Pornography
summary: Prohibits a person from possessing more than a specified number of images of certain child pornography or possessing or viewing images of certain child pornography depicting a minor or an individual indistinguishable from an actual and identifiable child under the specified age, provides that a violation is a felony and on conviction is subject to imprisonment not exceeding a specified number of years.

short_name: Maryland S 427 — Economic Competitiveness and Development Effort
full_name: Maryland S 427 — Economic Competitiveness and Development Effort
summary: Requires the Department of Commerce to evaluate the potential employment and economic growth of the State's industry sectors and establish a certain list of industry sectors and activities to be considered for additional support, repeals the State Economic Development Commission and Commerce Subcabinet, alters the designation, administration, and purposes of and eligibility for certain economic development programs, alters eligibility for and the calculation of certain economic development incentives.

short_name: Maryland S 429 — Excellence in Maryland Public Schools Act
full_name: Maryland S 429 — Excellence in Maryland Public Schools Act
summary: Alters the definitions of target per pupil foundation amount, collaborative time per pupil amount, and special education per pupil amount for certain fiscal years, alters the source of funds for the Blueprint for Maryland's Future Fund to include the interest earnings of the Academic Excellence Fund, freezes certain increases in the Concentration of Poverty School Grant Program for certain fiscal years, establishes the Collaborative Time Innovation Demonstration Grant and the Academic Excellence.

short_name: Maryland H 498 — Economic Competitiveness and Development Efforts
full_name: Maryland H 498 — Economic Competitiveness and Development Efforts
summary: Requires the Department of Commerce, evaluates the potential employment and economic growth of the State's industry sectors, establishes a certain list of industry sectors and activities, considers for additional support, repeals the Maryland Economic Development Commission and Commerce Subcabinet, alters the designation, administration, and purposes of and eligibility for certain economic development programs, alters eligibility for and the calculation of certain economic development incentives.

short_name: Maryland H 504 — Excellence in Maryland Public Schools Act
full_name: Maryland H 504 — Excellence in Maryland Public Schools Act
summary: Alters the source of funds for the Blueprint for Maryland's Future Fund to include the interest earnings of the Academic Excellence Fund, directs county boards of education to provide certain funding to local workforce development boards to support the Career Counseling Program for Middle and High School Students, alters a certain reporting requirement of local workforce development boards.

short_name: Maryland H 525 — Fraudulent Vote Influencing
full_name: Maryland H 525 — Fraudulent Vote Influencing
summary: Prohibits a person from using fraud, influences or attempts to influence a voter's voting decision, provides that fraud, includes the use of synthetic media, defines synthetic media as an image, an audio recording, or a video recording that has been intentionally created or manipulated with the use of generative artificial intelligence or other digital technology, creates a realistic but false image, audio recording, or video recording.

short_name: Maryland S 545 — Child Pornography
full_name: Maryland S 545 — Child Pornography
summary: Prohibits a person from possessing more than 100 images of certain child pornography or possessing or viewing images of certain child pornography depicting a minor or an individual indistinguishable from an actual and identifiable child under the age of 13 years, provides that a violation of the Act is a felony and on conviction is subject to imprisonment not exceeding 10 years.

short_name: Maryland H 589 — Artificial Intelligence Civil and Criminal Liabilities
full_name: Maryland H 589 — Artificial Intelligence Civil and Criminal Liabilities
summary: Establishes that a person who intentionally, knowingly, or negligently designs or creates artificial intelligence software able to cause physical injury or death is strictly liable for damages and subject to a civil penalty if the software is used to cause personal injury or death, prohibits a person from intentionally, knowingly, or negligently designing or creating artificial intelligence software able to cause injury or death.

short_name: Maryland S 609 — Rent Determination by Use of Algorithmic Device
full_name: Maryland S 609 — Rent Determination by Use of Algorithmic Device
summary: Prohibits a landlord from using certain algorithmic devices to determine the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant, makes a violation of the Act an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice under the Maryland Consumer Protection Act, applies the Act prospectively.

short_name: Maryland S 655 — Artificial Intelligence Evidence Clinic Pilot Program
full_name: Maryland S 655 — Artificial Intelligence Evidence Clinic Pilot Program
summary: Establishes an Artificial Intelligence Evidence Clinic Pilot Program within the Administrative Office of the Courts, requires the Administrative Office of the Courts to develop a grant application for the Program and award grants to eligible institutions of higher education, authorizes the Governor to include in the annual budget bill an appropriation to the Program and establishing a certain limitation on the expenditure of appropriated funds.

short_name: Maryland H 663 — Sexual Deepfake Representations and Revenge Porn
full_name: Maryland H 663 — Sexual Deepfake Representations and Revenge Porn
summary: Authorizes a person to bring and maintain a civil action for defamation against another person who distributes a computer-generated visual representation that is indistinguishable from an actual visual representation of the person and falsely depicts the person with his or her intimate parts exposed or engaged in sexual activity, clarifies what constitutes a visual representation for a certain prohibition against distributing a certain visual representation in a certain manner.

short_name: Maryland H 697 — Artificial Intelligence in Health Insurance Decisions
full_name: Maryland H 697 — Artificial Intelligence in Health Insurance Decisions
summary: Requires a health insurance carrier to submit quarterly reports to the State Insurance Commissioner on certain information related to the carrier's use of artificial intelligence or automated decision-making systems, alters the information related to adverse decisions and grievances carriers are required to report to the Commissioner.

short_name: Maryland S 704 — Evaluation on Artificial Intelligence in Public Schools
full_name: Maryland S 704 — Evaluation on Artificial Intelligence in Public Schools
summary: Requires the State Department of Education to conduct an evaluation on the use and potential use of artificial intelligence in public schools, requires that the evaluation consist of a survey of local school systems and a review of available systems that use artificial intelligence to assist with student learning, requires the Department of Information Technology to assist the State Department of Education in performing its review, requires the Department to issue a final report on the results.

short_name: Maryland H 740 — Campaign Materials Synthetic Media Usage Disclosure
full_name: Maryland H 740 — Campaign Materials Synthetic Media Usage Disclosure
summary: Requires that candidates, campaign finance entities, and specified other persons, or agents of candidates, campaign finance entities, or specified other persons, that publish, distribute, or disseminate, or cause to be published, distributed, or disseminated, to another person in the state campaign materials that use or contain synthetic media include a specified disclosure in a specified manner, defines synthetic media as an image, an audio recording, or a video recording.

short_name: Maryland H 782 — Study on Detecting Deadly Weapons in Schools
full_name: Maryland H 782 — Study on Detecting Deadly Weapons in Schools
summary: Requires the State Center for School Safety to study how best to detect deadly weapons in public middle and high schools and how best to rapidly report the detection of weapons to a law enforcement agency, requires the State Center for School Safety to request any available assessment of the technologies evaluated under this Act.

short_name: Maryland H 807 — Data Governance Modernization
full_name: Maryland H 807 — Data Governance Modernization
summary: Establishes the position and responsibilities of the State Chief Data Officer, establishes the Office of Enterprise Data in the Department of Information Technology and the responsibilities of the Office, requires each unit of state government to appoint an Agency Data Officer, renames the Council on Open Data to be the Council for Open Data Advancement, alters the membership, member terms, and responsibilities of the Council.

short_name: Maryland H 817 — Residential Leases Rent Determination
full_name: Maryland H 817 — Residential Leases Rent Determination
summary: Prohibits a landlord from using certain algorithmic devices to determine the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant, makes a violation of the Act an unfair, abusive, or deceptive trade practice under the State Consumer Protection Act, applies the Act prospectively.

short_name: Maryland H 823 — Generative Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Maryland H 823 — Generative Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires a developer of a generative artificial intelligence system, on or before a specified date, and before the developer releases or substantially modifies a certain generative artificial intelligence system, to publish on the developer's website documentation detailing the data used to train the generative artificial intelligence system.

short_name: Maryland S 897 — Student Technology and Social Media Resource Guide
full_name: Maryland S 897 — Student Technology and Social Media Resource Guide
summary: Requires the National Center for School Mental Health at the University of Maryland School of Medicine, in consultation with the State Department of Education, to develop and distribute a student technology and social media resource guide beginning in the 2027-2028 school year with additional information included in successive years, requires the Governor to include an appropriation of a specified amount for fiscal year 2027 and a specified amount for fiscal years 2028 and 2029 in the annual budget bill.

short_name: Maryland S 904 — Building Information Guardrails Data Act of 2025
full_name: Maryland S 904 — Building Information Guardrails Data Act of 2025
summary: Establishes the Privacy Protection and Enforcement Unit within the Division of Consumer Protection in the Office of the Attorney General, establishes a data broker registry, requires certain data brokers to register each year with the Comptroller, imposes a tax on the gross income of certain data brokers for taxable years beginning after a specified date.
