short_name: New York S 1815 — Publishers of Books Created With AI
full_name: New York S 1815 — Publishers of Books Created With AI
summary: Requires publishers of books created wholly or partially with the use of generative artificial intelligence to disclose such use of generative artificial intelligence before the completion of such sale, applies to all printed and digital books consisting of text, pictures, audio, puzzles, games or any combination thereof.

short_name: New York A 3125 — Use of Automated Housing Decision Making Tools
full_name: New York A 3125 — Use of Automated Housing Decision Making Tools
summary: Relates to the use of automated housing decision making tools to make housing decisions.

short_name: New York S 3243 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
full_name: New York S 3243 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
summary: Establishes a five-year dental health demonstration project in the county of Monroe for the purpose, reimburses to providers for eligible dental diagnostic services for certain eligible populations, includes but not limited to pregnant persons and post-partum persons.

short_name: New York A 3361 — Commission to Study Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York A 3361 — Commission to Study Artificial Intelligence
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation, repeals such commission.

short_name: New York A 3411 — Owner or Operator of a Generative AI System
full_name: New York A 3411 — Owner or Operator of a Generative AI System
summary: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system to conspicuously display a warning on the system's user interface that is reasonably calculated to consistently apprise the user that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate and/or inappropriate.

short_name: New York A 4002 — Discriminatory Advertisement Practices in Housing
full_name: New York A 4002 — Discriminatory Advertisement Practices in Housing
summary: Prohibits the use of discriminatory advertisement practices in housing.

short_name: New York S 4394 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Tools
full_name: New York S 4394 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Tools
summary: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools, provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

short_name: New York S 5025 — Dignity for All Students
full_name: New York S 5025 — Dignity for All Students
summary: Relates to updating provisions relating to dignity for all students, provides to post a written notification informing students about such policy and the name of the school employee designated to receive reports of harassment, bullying or discrimination in the school lobby and in every restroom used by students as well as other parts of the school where students are likely to see such posted notification.

short_name: New York A 6030 — Interactive Poker Games
full_name: New York A 6030 — Interactive Poker Games
summary: Allows certain interactive poker games be considered games of skill rather than games of luck, includes definitions, authorization, required safeguards and minimum standards, the scope of licensing review and state tax implications, makes corresponding penal law amendments.

short_name: New York A 6545 — Liability for Damages Caused by Chatbot
full_name: New York A 6545 — Liability for Damages Caused by Chatbot
summary: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating licensed professionals or giving any medical or psychological advice.

short_name: New York A 6578 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
full_name: New York A 6578 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, includes a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

short_name: New York A 6767 — Provision of an Artificial Intelligence Companion
full_name: New York A 6767 — Provision of an Artificial Intelligence Companion
summary: Prohibits the provision of an artificial intelligence companion to a user unless such artificial intelligence companion contains a protocol for addressing possible suicidal ideation or self-harm expressed by a user, possible physical harm to others expressed by a user, and possible financial harm to others expressed by a user, requires certain notifications to certain users regarding crisis service providers and the non-human nature of such companion models.

short_name: New York S 6954 — Stop Deepfakes Act
full_name: New York S 6954 — Stop Deepfakes Act
summary: Requires synthetic content creations system provider to apply provenance data, either directly or through the use of third-party technology, to synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that the synthetic content creations system provider makes available.

short_name: New York S 6955 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
full_name: New York S 6955 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

short_name: New York S 7033 — Algorithmic Pricing Discrimination Act
full_name: New York S 7033 — Algorithmic Pricing Discrimination Act
summary: Enacts the preventing algorithmic pricing discrimination act, requires the disclosure of algorithmically set prices.

short_name: New York A 7172 — Division of Criminal Justice Services
full_name: New York A 7172 — Division of Criminal Justice Services
summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to formulate a protocol for the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations.

short_name: New York S 7202 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
full_name: New York S 7202 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
summary: Establishes crimes for the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, amends the criminal procedure law, in relation to the statute of limitations for commencing cases related to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, repeals section 245.15 of the penal law relating to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_name: New York A 8022 — Operator of a Covered Platform
full_name: New York A 8022 — Operator of a Covered Platform
summary: Requires certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours.

short_name: New York S 8217 — Law Enforcement Agencies Staffed Hotline
full_name: New York S 8217 — Law Enforcement Agencies Staffed Hotline
summary: Relates to requiring certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours.

short_name: New York S 8589 — Automation Displacement Protection Act
full_name: New York S 8589 — Automation Displacement Protection Act
summary: Enacts the automation displacement protection act, relates to notice of technological displacement, provides that a covered employer shall provide no fewer than ninety days advance written notice prior to any technological displacement affecting twenty-five or more employees, or twenty-five percent of the workforce, whichever is less.

short_name: New York S 8616 — Pricing in Food and Drug Retail Establishments
full_name: New York S 8616 — Pricing in Food and Drug Retail Establishments
summary: Prohibits the use of electronic shelving labels, digital shelf display technology, and personalized algorithmic pricing in food retail establishments and drug retail establishments, provides injunctive relief, civil penalties, and a private right of action.

short_name: New York S 8623 — Use of Algorithmically Set Prices
full_name: New York S 8623 — Use of Algorithmically Set Prices
summary: Prohibits the use of algorithmically set prices, requires the disclosure of automated pricing systems, creates a private cause of action for violations of such prohibition.

short_name: New York S 8706 — Annual Reports on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York S 8706 — Annual Reports on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Amends the labor law, relates to requiring covered businesses to submit annual reports on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use, provides for penalties.

short_name: New York S 8721 — Likenesses Altered or Created by AI
full_name: New York S 8721 — Likenesses Altered or Created by AI
summary: Creates penalties for likenesses altered or created by artificial intelligence being used for commercial gain, establishes a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination of still or video images generated by artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York S 8828 — Responsible AI Safety and Education (Raise) Act
full_name: New York S 8828 — Responsible AI Safety and Education (Raise) Act
summary: Relates to transparency and safety requirements for developers of artificial intelligence frontier models, provides that a large frontier developer shall write, implement, comply with, and clearly and conspicuously publish on its internet website a frontier AI framework that applies to the large frontier developers frontier models and describes in detail how the large frontier developer handles, among other things, cybersecurity practices to secure unreleased model weights from unauthorized modification.

short_name: New York S 8831 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Making Tools
full_name: New York S 8831 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Making Tools
summary: Provides for the use of automated employment decision-making tools and artificial intelligence systems by a county, city, town, village, school district, board of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension board, district corporation, the state university of New York, the city university of New York, or community college, amends the effectiveness thereof.

short_name: New York A 8843 — State Opportunity Promise Scholarship
full_name: New York A 8843 — State Opportunity Promise Scholarship
summary: Amends the education law, in relation to the qualification of an applicant for the New York opportunity promise scholarship.

short_name: New York S 8872 — Algorithmic Wage Setting
full_name: New York S 8872 — Algorithmic Wage Setting
summary: Prohibits algorithmic wage-setting, provides for exceptions, provides for penalties for violation, creates a private right of action.

short_name: New York S 8874 — Disclosure of the Use of Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York S 8874 — Disclosure of the Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires disclosure of the use of artificial intelligence in customer services at the point of interaction with the customer, defines terms.

short_name: New York A 8884 — Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems
full_name: New York A 8884 — Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: Regulates the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination, requires independent audits of high risk ai systems, provides for enforcement by the attorney general as well as a private right of action.

short_name: New York S 8928 — Artificial Intelligence Workforce Impact Transparency
full_name: New York S 8928 — Artificial Intelligence Workforce Impact Transparency
summary: Enacts the Artificial Intelligence Workforce Impact Transparency, requires that each notice include a statement as to whether the employment losses described are the result, in whole or in part, of the introduction, expansion, or adoption of artificial intelligence systems, automation technologies, or machine-based processes that have replaced or materially altered the duties of affected employees.

short_name: New York S 9028 — Employment Discrimination
full_name: New York S 9028 — Employment Discrimination
summary: Prohibits employers from engaging in discrimination on the basis of a protected class when using artificial intelligence for recruitment, hiring, promotion, renewal of employment, selection for training or apprenticeship, discharge, discipline, tenure, or the terms, privileges, or conditions of employment.

short_name: New York S 9051 — Artificial Intelligence Chatbots
full_name: New York S 9051 — Artificial Intelligence Chatbots
summary: Prohibits artificial intelligence chatbots from using features which are considered unsafe for minors, defines terms, specifies what are considered unsafe features, provides rights of action, directs rules and regulations to be established.

short_name: New York S 9088 — Registration of Data Brokers
full_name: New York S 9088 — Registration of Data Brokers
summary: Requires the registration of data brokers, imposes regulations upon data brokers, establishes a data deletion mechanism for consumers, imposes penalties upon data brokers for violations of the law.

short_name: New York S 9089 — Food Delivery Worker Safety and Fair Algorithms Act
full_name: New York S 9089 — Food Delivery Worker Safety and Fair Algorithms Act
summary: Enacts the ""food delivery worker safety and fair algorithms act"" to prohibit food delivery platforms from utilizing or deploying any algorithmic management system that requires or incentivizes delivery workers to complete deliveries within a fixed or rigid time window that cannot reasonably be met while complying with all applicable traffic Laws and safety regulations, penalizes, deactivates, suspends, deprioritizes, or otherwise limits a delivery worker's access to work opportunities for failure to meet.

short_name: New York A 9106 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in Provision of Therapy
full_name: New York A 9106 — Use of Artificial Intelligence in Provision of Therapy
summary: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in the provision of therapy or psychotherapy services by prohibiting the use of artificial intelligence to assist in providing supplementary support where the session is recorded or transcribed unless the patient is informed of the specific purpose of such use and consents of such use, establishes penalties for violations of such provisions, excludes religious counseling, peer-support, and self-help materials and educational resources from such provisions.

short_name: New York S 9131 — Data Broker Regulation
full_name: New York S 9131 — Data Broker Regulation
summary: Relates to data broker regulation, prohibits the acquisition of personally identifiable information through fraudulent means, requires a data broker to develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive information security program, requires data brokers operating in the state of New York to register with the attorney general.

short_name: New York S 9132 — Use of a Wage Fixing Algorithm to Set Wages
full_name: New York S 9132 — Use of a Wage Fixing Algorithm to Set Wages
summary: Prohibits the use of a wage-fixing algorithm in combination with personal or behavioral data to set or recommend wages or compensation, defines terms, establishes penalties for violations of such prohibition.

short_name: New York A 9219 — Artificial Intelligence Technology
full_name: New York A 9219 — Artificial Intelligence Technology
summary: Requires experts in professional fields to be consulted when developing and maintaining artificial intelligence technology for use in such fields.

short_name: New York S 9236 — False Reporting of Incidents Using AI
full_name: New York S 9236 — False Reporting of Incidents Using AI
summary: Includes communications generated using artificial intelligence in the definition of falsely reporting an incident in the third degree.

short_name: New York A 9253 — Policing Agencies
full_name: New York A 9253 — Policing Agencies
summary: Amends the executive law, in relation to requiring policing agencies to conduct an inventory of, and develop a publicly available policy for, any artificial intelligence used to aid criminal investigations.

short_name: New York S 9269 — Protection of Health Information
full_name: New York S 9269 — Protection of Health Information
summary: Provides for the protection of health information, establishes requirements for communications to individuals about their health information, requires either written consent or a designated necessary purpose for the processing of an individual's health information.

short_name: New York S 9390 — Civil, Criminal or Family Court Proceedings
full_name: New York S 9390 — Civil, Criminal or Family Court Proceedings
summary: Provides that in any civil, criminal or family court proceeding, where evidence is offered and a party contends that such evidence has been fabricated by means of generative artificial intelligence, the court shall not, on that ground alone, conduct an inquiry into such alleged fabrication unless the party so contending makes a showing sufficient to support a reasonable inference that the evidence may not be authentic.

short_name: New York A 9449 — Transparency Requirements for Developers of AI Models
full_name: New York A 9449 — Transparency Requirements for Developers of AI Models
summary: Implements transparency requirements for developers of AI models, requires the establishment of an office for oversite of AI model developer transparency and reporting, makes related provisions.

short_name: New York A 9487 — Use of Automated Decision Making Tools
full_name: New York A 9487 — Use of Automated Decision Making Tools
summary: Provides for the use of automated employment decision-making tools and artificial intelligence systems by a county, city, town, village, school district, board of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension board, district corporation, the state university of New York, the city university of New York, or community college, amends the effectiveness thereof.

short_name: New York A 9533 — Automation Displacement Protection Act
full_name: New York A 9533 — Automation Displacement Protection Act
summary: Requires covered employers to provide notice to certain affected employees prior to any technological displacement, requires reporting, requires a workforce transition period, makes related provisions.

short_name: New York A 9581 — Department of Labor Reports
full_name: New York A 9581 — Department of Labor Reports
summary: Relates to requiring covered businesses to submit annual reports on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use.

short_name: New York S 9584 — Misleading Representations in Real Estate Listings
full_name: New York S 9584 — Misleading Representations in Real Estate Listings
summary: Designates materially misleading digital representations in real estate listings as an unfair, deceptive or abusive act or false advertising, provides that a licensed real estate broker or salesperson shall be subject to suspension or revocation of their license for a violation of such provisions.

short_name: New York A 9601 — Use of Automated Systems to Make Employment Decisions
full_name: New York A 9601 — Use of Automated Systems to Make Employment Decisions
summary: Prohibits the use of automated systems to make employment decisions unless there is a meaningful human review of the output of such automated system prior to the final employment decision, requires employers that use an automated system in the hiring process to notify applicants of the use of such system, provides that an applicant who has received an adverse employment decision may request a human-conducted review of such decision.

short_name: New York A 9638 — Use of a Wage Fixing Algorithm
full_name: New York A 9638 — Use of a Wage Fixing Algorithm
summary: Prohibits the use of a wage-fixing algorithm in combination with personal or behavioral data to set or recommend wages or compensation, defines terms, establishes penalties for violations of such prohibition.

short_name: New York A 9641 — Algorithmic Wage Setting
full_name: New York A 9641 — Algorithmic Wage Setting
summary: Prohibits algorithmic wage-setting, provides for exceptions, provides for penalties for violation, creates a private right of action.

short_name: New York A 9654 — State Artificial Intelligence Civil Rights Act
full_name: New York A 9654 — State Artificial Intelligence Civil Rights Act
summary: Enacts the State Artificial Intelligence Civil Rights Act establishing protections for individual rights with respect to computational algorithms, establishes protections against the use of algorithms involved in consequential decisions, such as those that impact people's rights, civil liberties, and livelihoods, including employment, banking, health care, the criminal justice system, public accommodations, and government services.

short_name: New York S 9700 — Use of Algorithmic Device by Landlord to Determine Rent
full_name: New York S 9700 — Use of Algorithmic Device by Landlord to Determine Rent
summary: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant, declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

short_name: New York S 9794 — Filings Produced Using Generative AI
full_name: New York S 9794 — Filings Produced Using Generative AI
summary: Amends the Civil Practice Law & Rules Law, requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence, requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

short_name: New York S 9819 — Department of Labor
full_name: New York S 9819 — Department of Labor
summary: Directs the department of labor to conduct a study and prepare a report on the effects of artificial intelligence on job losses in the state.

short_name: New York S 10025 — State-Level Public Employers
full_name: New York S 10025 — State-Level Public Employers
summary: Requires state-level public employers that intend to begin any procurement process or plan to acquire or deploy any new application or technology that utilizes an artificial intelligence model or artificial intelligence system to notify any duly recognized and certified employee representative of such intention no less than twelve months before commencing such process.

short_name: New York A 10047 — Disclosure Requirements for AI Generated Media
full_name: New York A 10047 — Disclosure Requirements for AI Generated Media
summary: Establishes disclosure requirements for AI-generated or materially AI-altered media depicting historically recognized human disasters when such media is publicly distributed, requires platform operators to allow the use of labelling, provides for enforcement by the attorney general.

short_name: New York S 10049 — Definition of Cyberbullying
full_name: New York S 10049 — Definition of Cyberbullying
summary: Updates the definition of cyberbullying in the dignity for all students act to include intentionally using artificial intelligence to mimic or alter a person's likeness or voice without their consent.

short_name: New York A 10118 — Food Delivery Worker Safety and Fair Algorithms Act
full_name: New York A 10118 — Food Delivery Worker Safety and Fair Algorithms Act
summary: Enacts the ""food delivery worker safety and fair algorithms act"" to prohibit food delivery platforms from utilizing or deploying any algorithmic management system that requires or incentivizes delivery workers to complete deliveries within a fixed or rigid time window that cannot reasonably be met while complying with all applicable traffic Laws and safety regulations, penalizes, deactivates, suspends, deprioritizes, or otherwise limits a delivery worker's access to work opportunities for failure to meet.

short_name: New York A 10183 — Transitional Wage Insurance Program
full_name: New York A 10183 — Transitional Wage Insurance Program
summary: Establishes the transitional wage insurance program under which the department of labor provides temporary supplemental payments to eligible individuals who accept new employment at a lower wage than their prior employment.

short_name: New York A 10251 — Use of Automatic Data Systems with Employment
full_name: New York A 10251 — Use of Automatic Data Systems with Employment
summary: Limits the use of automatic data systems in connection with employment, requires an employer shall provide a written notice that an automatic data system is being used, provides remedies.

short_name: New York A 10364 — Disclosures By Automobile Insurers
full_name: New York A 10364 — Disclosures By Automobile Insurers
summary: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates and/or discounts.

short_name: New York A 10379 — Unsafe Chatbot Features for Minors
full_name: New York A 10379 — Unsafe Chatbot Features for Minors
summary: Prohibits artificial intelligence chatbots from using features which are considered unsafe for minors, provides that it shall be unlawful for a chatbot operator to provide unsafe chatbot features to a covered user unless the covered user is not a covered minor and the chatbot operator has used methods to determine that the covered user is not a covered minor, provides exceptions for certain advanced chatbots, relates to civil actions for violations.

short_name: New York A 10764 — Utility Billing Integrity Act
full_name: New York A 10764 — Utility Billing Integrity Act
summary: Enacts the utility billing integrity act to establish utility billing integrity and consumer protections through anomaly detection, advanced data analytics and the usage of artificial intelligence, requires every utility to implement and maintain a billing integrity program utilizing anomaly detection systems to review all residential utility bills prior to issuance, provides that where a billing anomaly is identified, the utility shall provide prompt notice to the customer that the bill is under review.

short_name: New York A 10909 — Shirley Myers White Right To Reconciliation Act
full_name: New York A 10909 — Shirley Myers White Right To Reconciliation Act
summary: Enacts the ""Shirley Myers White Right To Reconciliation and Digital Identity Repair Act"", establishes a right for individuals to have outdated, inaccurate, or incomplete public and digital narratives corrected once a legal matter is resolved, requires institutions to provide mechanisms for context, updates, and correction so that individuals are not permanently penalized by disproven or obsolete information in digital and automated systems.

short_name: New York A 11048 — Use of Artificial Intelligence by Insurers
full_name: New York A 11048 — Use of Artificial Intelligence by Insurers
summary: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence by insurers and clinical peer reviewers for utilization review, establishes additional notice requirements for adverse determinations.

short_name: New York S 185 — Automated Employment Decision Tools
full_name: New York S 185 — Automated Employment Decision Tools
summary: Amends the labor law, in relation to restricting the use of electronic monitoring and automated employment decision tools and to amend the civil rights law, in relation to making a conforming change.

short_name: New York S 205 — Unlawful Publication of Intimate Images
full_name: New York S 205 — Unlawful Publication of Intimate Images
summary: Establishes that when an actor threatens to disseminate or publish a still or video image depicting such other person with one or more intimate parts exposed or engaging in sexual conduct with another person, including a still or video image created or altered by digitization, where such person may reasonably be identified from the still or video image itself or from information displayed in connection with the still or video image within the provisions of unlawful dissemination or publication.

short_name: New York A 222 — Chatbots and Misleading or Harmful Information
full_name: New York A 222 — Chatbots and Misleading or Harmful Information
summary: Imposes liability for misleading, incorrect, contradictory or harmful information to a user by a chatbot that results in financial loss or other demonstrable harm.

short_name: New York A 235 — Artificial Intelligence System
full_name: New York A 235 — Artificial Intelligence System
summary: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a visual or audio generative artificial intelligence system to take steps to prohibit its users from creating unauthorized realistic depictions of public officials.

short_name: New York A 399 — Robotic Device
full_name: New York A 399 — Robotic Device
summary: Prohibits the manufacture, modification, sale, transfer, equipping, use, or operation of a robotic device or an uncrewed aircraft equipped or mounted with a weapon within the state.

short_name: New York A 433 — Automated Employment Decision Making Tools
full_name: New York A 433 — Automated Employment Decision Making Tools
summary: Relates to the disclosure of automated employment decision-making tools, requires the office of information technology services to maintain an artificial intelligence inventory, provides that the use of artificial intelligence systems shall not affect the existing rights of employees pursuant to an existing collective bargaining agreement, or the existing representational relationships among employee organizations or the bargaining relationships between the employer and an employee organization.

short_name: New York S 463 — Promotion of Unlawful Material
full_name: New York S 463 — Promotion of Unlawful Material
summary: Prohibits the knowing and reckless promotion of unlawful or false material, provides remedies for the violation of such prohibition.

short_name: New York A 563 — Automatic License Plate Reader Systems
full_name: New York A 563 — Automatic License Plate Reader Systems
summary: Requires policies for the use of automatic license plate reader systems, develop, maintain and disseminate a minimum standards policy governing the use of automatic license plate reader systems by non-law enforcement entities and non-government entities.

short_name: New York A 606 — Use of a Synthetic Performer
full_name: New York A 606 — Use of a Synthetic Performer
summary: Requires advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer, imposes a specified amount of civil penalty for a first violation and a specified amount penalty for any subsequent violation.

short_name: New York A 768 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protection Act
full_name: New York A 768 — Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protection Act
summary: Enacts the ""New York artificial intelligence consumer protection act"", in relation to preventing the use of artificial intelligence algorithms to discriminate against protected classes.

short_name: New York A 773 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Banks
full_name: New York A 773 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Banks
summary: Relates to the use of automated lending decision-making tools to make lending decisions.

short_name: New York S 823 — Model Management Group
full_name: New York S 823 — Model Management Group
summary: Defines model management group, provides for the registration process for model management groups, provides for exemption from registration requirements for model management companies and groups.

short_name: New York A 907 — Automatic License Plate Readers
full_name: New York A 907 — Automatic License Plate Readers
summary: Relates to automatic license plate readers (ALPRs) and mandatory postings of policies and annual reporting requirements.

short_name: New York S 933 — Position of Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer
full_name: New York S 933 — Position of Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer
summary: Establishes the position of chief artificial intelligence officer and such person's functions, powers and duties, including, but not limited to, developing statewide artificial intelligence policies and governance, coordinating the activities of any and all state departments, boards, commissions, agencies and authorities performing any functions using artificial intelligence tools, makes related provisions.

short_name: New York S 934 — Owner of Generative Artificial Intelligence System
full_name: New York S 934 — Owner of Generative Artificial Intelligence System
summary: Requires notices on generative artificial intelligence systems, provides the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system shall clearly and conspicuously display a notice on the system's user interface that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate.

short_name: New York A 1071 — Reckless Promotion of Unlawful or False Material
full_name: New York A 1071 — Reckless Promotion of Unlawful or False Material
summary: Prohibits the knowing and reckless promotion of unlawful or false material, provides remedies for the violation of such prohibition.

short_name: New York S 1169 — Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems
full_name: New York S 1169 — Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: Regulates the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination, requires independent audits of high risk ai systems, provides for enforcement by the attorney general as well as a private right of action.

short_name: New York A 1205 — Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer
full_name: New York A 1205 — Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer
summary: Establishes the position of chief artificial intelligence officer and such person's functions, powers and duties, includes, but not limited to, developing statewide artificial intelligence policies and governance, coordinating the activities of any and all state departments, boards, commissions, agencies and authorities performing any functions using artificial intelligence tools, makes related provisions.

short_name: New York S 1228 — Advertisements
full_name: New York S 1228 — Advertisements
summary: Requires advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer, imposes a specified dollar civil penalty for a first violation and a specified dollar penalty for any subsequent violation.

short_name: New York A 1273 — Motor Vehicle Insurers Discrimination
full_name: New York A 1273 — Motor Vehicle Insurers Discrimination
summary: Prohibits motor vehicle insurers from discrimination on the basis of socioeconomic factors in determining algorithms used to construct actuarial tables, coverage terms, premiums and/or rates.

short_name: New York S 1274 — Commission on Forensic Science
full_name: New York S 1274 — Commission on Forensic Science
summary: Updates the membership, powers, duties and procedures of the commission on forensic science, establishes the scientific advisory committee, the social justice, ethics, and equity assessment committee and the forensic analyst license advisory committee, makes conforming changes.

short_name: New York A 1280 — Unlawful Dissemination of Fabricated Images or Audio
full_name: New York A 1280 — Unlawful Dissemination of Fabricated Images or Audio
summary: Establishes the crime of unlawful dissemination or publication of a fabricated photographic, videographic, or audio record as a class E felony.

short_name: New York A 1332 — State Office of Algorithmic Innovation
full_name: New York A 1332 — State Office of Algorithmic Innovation
summary: Creates a state office of algorithmic innovation to set policies and standards to ensure algorithms are safe, effective, fair, and ethical, and that the state is conducive to promoting algorithmic innovation.

short_name: New York A 1338 — Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York A 1338 — Artificial Intelligence
summary: Sets rules and procedures for the admissibility of evidence created or processed by artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York A 1342 — Advanced Artificial Intelligence Systems
full_name: New York A 1342 — Advanced Artificial Intelligence Systems
summary: Requires the collection of oaths of responsible use from users of certain generative or surveillance advanced artificial intelligence systems by the operators of such systems, and transmission of such oaths to the attorney general.

short_name: New York A 1415 — Privacy Standards for Electronic Health Products
full_name: New York A 1415 — Privacy Standards for Electronic Health Products
summary: Creates privacy standards for electronic health products and services, requires consent to be given for the collection and/or sharing of personal health information or other personal data.

short_name: New York A 1417 — Landlords
full_name: New York A 1417 — Landlords
summary: Amends the general business law, in relation to prohibiting the use of algorithmic pricing by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant.

short_name: New York A 1447 — Use of Facial Recognition and Biometric Information
full_name: New York A 1447 — Use of Facial Recognition and Biometric Information
summary: Prohibits the use of facial recognition and biometric information as the sole factor in determining the existence of probable cause to place in custody or arrest an individual.

short_name: New York A 1456 — Insurer Notice Requirements
full_name: New York A 1456 — Insurer Notice Requirements
summary: Provides for notice requirements where an insurer authorized to write accident and health insurance in this state, a corporation organized pursuant to article forty-three of this chapter, or a health maintenance organization certified pursuant to article forty-four of the public health law uses artificial intelligence-based algorithms in the utilization review process.

short_name: New York A 1509 — Publishers of Books Created by AI
full_name: New York A 1509 — Publishers of Books Created by AI
summary: Requires publishers of books created wholly or partially with the use of generative artificial intelligence to disclose such use of generative artificial intelligence before the completion of such sale, applies to all printed and digital books consisting of text, pictures, audio, puzzles, games or any combination thereof.

short_name: New York S 1573 — Collecting of Information for Rental Pricing
full_name: New York S 1573 — Collecting of Information for Rental Pricing
summary: Prohibits the collecting of information of historical or contemporaneous prices, supply levels, or lease or rental contract termination and renewal dates of residential dwelling units from two or more rental property owners for purposes of analyzing or processing of such information using an algorithm and of recommending rental prices, lease renewal terms, or ideal occupancy levels to a rental property owner.

short_name: New York S 1815 — Publishers of Books Created With AI
full_name: New York S 1815 — Publishers of Books Created With AI
summary: Requires publishers of books created wholly or partially with the use of generative artificial intelligence to disclose such use of generative artificial intelligence before the completion of such sale, applies to all printed and digital books consisting of text, pictures, audio, puzzles, games or any combination thereof.

short_name: New York S 1854 — New York Workforce Stabilization Act
full_name: New York S 1854 — New York Workforce Stabilization Act
summary: Establishes the New York Workforce Stabilization Act, requires certain businesses to conduct artificial intelligence impact assessments on the application and use of such artificial intelligence and to submit such impact assessments to the Department of Labor prior to the implementation of the artificial intelligence, establishes a surcharge on certain corporations that use artificial intelligence or data mining or have greater than fifteen employees displaced by artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York A 1922 — Automatic License Plate Reader Systems at State Parks
full_name: New York A 1922 — Automatic License Plate Reader Systems at State Parks
summary: Requires the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to promulgate rules and regulations requiring the use of automatic license plate reader systems at all entrances and exits to state parks and to assist municipalities in establishing policies and procedures for similar use of such license plate readers.

short_name: New York A 1952 — Employers and Employment Agencies
full_name: New York A 1952 — Employers and Employment Agencies
summary: Requires employers and employment agencies to notify candidates for employment if machine learning technology is used to make hiring decisions prior to the use of such technology.

short_name: New York S 1962 — NY Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protection Act
full_name: New York S 1962 — NY Artificial Intelligence Consumer Protection Act
summary: Enacts the ""New York artificial intelligence consumer protection act"", in relation to preventing the use of artificial intelligence algorithms to discriminate against protected classes.

short_name: New York A 2226 — Unlawful Dissemination of Sexual Video or Image
full_name: New York A 2226 — Unlawful Dissemination of Sexual Video or Image
summary: Establishes that when an actor threatens to disseminate or publish a still or video image depicting such other person with one or more intimate parts exposed or engaging in sexual conduct with another person, including a still or video image created or altered by digitization, where such person may reasonably be identified from the still or video image itself or from information displayed in connection with the still or video image within the provisions of unlawful dissemination or publication.

short_name: New York S 2414 — Political Artificial Intelligence Disclaimer Act
full_name: New York S 2414 — Political Artificial Intelligence Disclaimer Act
summary: Enacts the ""Political Artificial Intelligence Disclaimer (PAID) act"", requires political communications that use synthetic media to disclose that they were created with the assistance of artificial intelligence, requires committees that use synthetic media to maintain records of such usage.

short_name: New York S 2487 — New York Artificial Intelligence Ethics Commission
full_name: New York S 2487 — New York Artificial Intelligence Ethics Commission
summary: Establishes the New York artificial intelligence ethics commission.

short_name: New York S 2697 — Use of an Algorithmic Device by a Landlord
full_name: New York S 2697 — Use of an Algorithmic Device by a Landlord
summary: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant, declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

short_name: New York S 2698 — Certification of Filings Produced Using Generative AI
full_name: New York S 2698 — Certification of Filings Produced Using Generative AI
summary: Amends the Civil Practice Law & Rules Law, requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence, requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

short_name: New York A 3071 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
full_name: New York A 3071 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
summary: Establishes a five-year dental health demonstration project in the county of Monroe for the purpose of reimbursement to providers for eligible dental diagnostic services for certain eligible populations, including but not limited to pregnant persons and post-partum persons.

short_name: New York A 3125 — Use of Automated Housing Decision Making Tools
full_name: New York A 3125 — Use of Automated Housing Decision Making Tools
summary: Relates to the use of automated housing decision making tools to make housing decisions.

short_name: New York S 3133 — Robotic Device or Uncrewed Aircraft with a Weapon
full_name: New York S 3133 — Robotic Device or Uncrewed Aircraft with a Weapon
summary: Prohibits the manufacture, modification, sale, transfer, equipping, use, or operation of a robotic device or an uncrewed aircraft equipped or mounted with a weapon within the State.

short_name: New York S 3202 — Sexually Explicit Depictions of Children
full_name: New York S 3202 — Sexually Explicit Depictions of Children
summary: Prohibits accessing or distributing certain sexually explicit depictions of children, prohibits consent to such depictions by anyone under eighteen years of age, makes such crimes eligible for bail, includes certain crimes as sex offenses.

short_name: New York S 3243 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
full_name: New York S 3243 — Five Year Dental Health Demonstration Project
summary: Establishes a five-year dental health demonstration project in the county of Monroe for the purpose, reimburses to providers for eligible dental diagnostic services for certain eligible populations, includes but not limited to pregnant persons and post-partum persons.

short_name: New York A 3265 — New York Artificial Intelligence Bill of Rights
full_name: New York A 3265 — New York Artificial Intelligence Bill of Rights
summary: Enacts the New York artificial intelligence bill of rights to provide residents of the state with rights and protections to ensure that any system making decisions without human intervention impacting their lives do so lawfully, properly, and with meaningful oversight.

short_name: New York A 3327 — Political Communication Requirement
full_name: New York A 3327 — Political Communication Requirement
summary: Requires any political communication, whether made by phone call, email or other message-based communication, that utilizes an artificial intelligence system to engage in human-like conversation with another shall, by reasonable means, apprise the person of the fact that they are communicating with an artificial intelligence system.

short_name: New York A 3356 — Advanced Artificial Intelligence Licensing Act
full_name: New York A 3356 — Advanced Artificial Intelligence Licensing Act
summary: Enacts the ""advanced artificial intelligence licensing act"", provides for regulation of advanced artificial intelligence systems (Part A), requires registration and licensing of high-risk advanced artificial intelligence systems and related provisions regarding the operation of such systems (Part B), establishes the advanced artificial intelligence ethical code of conduct (Part C), prohibits the development and operation of certain artificial intelligence systems (Part D).

short_name: New York A 3361 — Commission to Study Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York A 3361 — Commission to Study Artificial Intelligence
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation, repeals such commission.

short_name: New York A 3411 — Owner or Operator of a Generative AI System
full_name: New York A 3411 — Owner or Operator of a Generative AI System
summary: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system to conspicuously display a warning on the system's user interface that is reasonably calculated to consistently apprise the user that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate and/or inappropriate.

short_name: New York A 3437 — Food Service Establishments
full_name: New York A 3437 — Food Service Establishments
summary: Prohibits food service establishments from using a dynamic pricing model in determining the prices on its menu, requires fixed prices be published on a food service establishment's menu.

short_name: New York A 3719 — Tax on Business-Induced Job Displacement
full_name: New York A 3719 — Tax on Business-Induced Job Displacement
summary: Imposes a tax on certain businesses when people are displaced from their employment due to certain technologies based on the sum of any taxes or fees imposed by the state or any political subdivision thereof computed based on a displaced employee's wage.

short_name: New York A 3779 — Regulation of AI in Hiring Decisions
full_name: New York A 3779 — Regulation of AI in Hiring Decisions
summary: Restricts the use by an employer or an employment agency of electronic monitoring or an automated employment decision tool, screens a candidate or employee for an employment decision unless such tool has been the subject of an impact assessment within the last year, requires notice to employment candidates of the use of such tools, provides remedies for violations.

short_name: New York A 3914 — Automated Hiring Decision Tool Regulation
full_name: New York A 3914 — Automated Hiring Decision Tool Regulation
summary: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools, provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

short_name: New York A 3924 — Privacy Rights Involving Digitization
full_name: New York A 3924 — Privacy Rights Involving Digitization
summary: Relates to privacy rights involving digitization, provides that such right of privacy and action for injunction and damages shall include a portrait, picture, likeness or voice created or altered by digitization.

short_name: New York A 3930 — Use of AI in Rental Housing and Loan Decisions
full_name: New York A 3930 — Use of AI in Rental Housing and Loan Decisions
summary: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in aiding decisions on rental housing and loans, requires a study on the impact of artificial intelligence and machine learning on housing discrimination and redlining.

short_name: New York A 3932 — Third Party Food Delivery Platforms
full_name: New York A 3932 — Third Party Food Delivery Platforms
summary: Prohibits third-party food delivery platforms from employing algorithms that promote unsafe operation of e-bikes and scooters to improve safety for third-party food deliveries.

short_name: New York A 3969 — Commission on Forensic Science
full_name: New York A 3969 — Commission on Forensic Science
summary: Updates the membership, powers, duties and procedures of the commission on forensic science, establishes the scientific advisory committee, the social justice, ethics, and equity assessment committee and the forensic analyst license advisory committee, makes conforming changes.

short_name: New York A 3991 — Requirements for the Use of Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York A 3991 — Requirements for the Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Establishes requirements for the use of artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tools in utilization review and management, defines artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York A 3993 — Discrimination Through the Use of Clinical Algorithms
full_name: New York A 3993 — Discrimination Through the Use of Clinical Algorithms
summary: Prohibits discrimination through the use of clinical algorithms, provides exceptions for clinical algorithms that rely on variables to appropriately make decisions, includes to identify, evaluate, and address health disparities.

short_name: New York A 4002 — Discriminatory Advertisement Practices in Housing
full_name: New York A 4002 — Discriminatory Advertisement Practices in Housing
summary: Prohibits discriminatory advertisement practices in relation to the sale or renting of housing, allows for the division of human rights to investigate such occurrences.

short_name: New York S 4082 — Motor Vehicle Insurers
full_name: New York S 4082 — Motor Vehicle Insurers
summary: Prohibits motor vehicle insurers from discrimination on the basis of socioeconomic factors in determining algorithms used to construct actuarial tables, coverage terms, premiums and/or rates.

short_name: New York S 4394 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Tools
full_name: New York S 4394 — Use of Automated Employment Decision Tools
summary: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools, provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

short_name: New York A 4427 — Use of External Consumer Data and Information Sources
full_name: New York A 4427 — Use of External Consumer Data and Information Sources
summary: Prohibits the use of external consumer data and information sources being used when determining insurance rates, provides that no insurer shall unfairly discriminate based on race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, or gender expression, or use any external consumer data and information sources, as well as any algorithms or predictive models that use external consumer data and information sources, in a way that unfairly discriminates based on.

short_name: New York A 4550 — Department of Labor
full_name: New York A 4550 — Department of Labor
summary: Requires the Department of Labor to study the long-term impact of artificial intelligence on the state workforce including but not limited to on job performance, productivity, training, education requirements, privacy and security, prohibits any state entity from using artificial intelligence in any way that would displace any natural person from their employment with such state entity until the department's final report is received.

short_name: New York A 4947 — NY Privacy Act
full_name: New York A 4947 — NY Privacy Act
summary: Enacts the NY privacy act to require companies to disclose their methods of de-identifying personal information, to place special safeguards around data sharing and to allow consumers to obtain the Names of all entities with whom their information is shared.

short_name: New York A 4970 — School Safety Planning and Training
full_name: New York A 4970 — School Safety Planning and Training
summary: Relates to classroom safety mechanisms, emergency medical equipment, and evidence-based best practices for school safety planning and training.

short_name: New York A 4987 — New York Veteran Digital Navigator Program Act
full_name: New York A 4987 — New York Veteran Digital Navigator Program Act
summary: Enacts the State Veteran Digital Navigator Program Act, requires the state commissioner of the Department of Veterans' Services, establishes a program, promotes digital citizenship, through which the state commissioner shall award grants to eligible entities.

short_name: New York A 4991 — Use of Algorithmic Devices by Landlords
full_name: New York A 4991 — Use of Algorithmic Devices by Landlords
summary: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant, declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

short_name: New York A 5216 — State Units
full_name: New York A 5216 — State Units
summary: Requires state units to purchase a product or service that is or contains an algorithmic decision system that adheres to responsible artificial intelligence standards, specifies content included in responsible artificial intelligence standards, requires the commissioner of taxation and finance to adopt certain regulations, alters the definition of unlawful discriminatory practice to include acts performed through algorithmic decision systems.

short_name: New York S 5267 — Property and Casualty Insurers
full_name: New York S 5267 — Property and Casualty Insurers
summary: Prohibits property/casualty insurers from discriminating based on race, color, creed, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, education background or educational level attained, employment status or occupation, income level, consumer credit information or score, ownership or interest in real property, location, type of residence, including but not limited to single-family home, multi-family home, apartment, housing subsidized by state and/or federal programs.

short_name: New York A 5429 — New York Workforce Stabilization Act
full_name: New York A 5429 — New York Workforce Stabilization Act
summary: Relates to requiring certain businesses to conduct artificial intelligence impact assessments, amends the tax law, in relation to establishing a surcharge on certain corporations that use artificial intelligence or data mining or have greater than a threshold number of employees displaced by artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York S 5486 — Disclosures by Automobile Insurers
full_name: New York S 5486 — Disclosures by Automobile Insurers
summary: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates or discounts.

short_name: New York S 5668 — Liability for Harmful Information from Chatbot
full_name: New York S 5668 — Liability for Harmful Information from Chatbot
summary: Imposes liability for misleading, incorrect, contradictory or harmful information to a user by a chatbot that results in financial loss or other demonstrable harm.

short_name: New York A 5689 — Computer Science Course Requirement
full_name: New York A 5689 — Computer Science Course Requirement
summary: Creates a computer science course requirement for graduation from high school, directs the Department of Education to design and implement such program.

short_name: New York A 5827 — Consumers' Foundational Data Privacy Rights
full_name: New York A 5827 — Consumers' Foundational Data Privacy Rights
summary: Establishes Consumers' Foundational Data Privacy Rights, creates oversight mechanisms, establishes enforcement mechanisms, establishes the Privacy and Security Victims' Relief Fund.

short_name: New York A 6030 — Interactive Poker Games
full_name: New York A 6030 — Interactive Poker Games
summary: Allows certain interactive poker games be considered games of skill rather than games of luck, includes definitions, authorization, required safeguards and minimum standards, the scope of licensing review and state tax implications, makes corresponding penal law amendments.

short_name: New York A 6180 — Production Using Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York A 6180 — Production Using Artificial Intelligence
summary: Excludes a production using artificial intelligence or autonomous vehicles in a manner which results in the displacement of employees whose salaries are qualified expenses from the definition of qualified film for the purposes of the empire state film production credit.

short_name: New York S 6270 — Third Party Food Delivery Services
full_name: New York S 6270 — Third Party Food Delivery Services
summary: Requires third-party food delivery services to factor compliance with certain vehicle and traffic Laws when assigning workers to delivery routes when such delivery may involve the operation of a bicycle with or without electric assist.

short_name: New York S 6278 — Aggravated Harassment by Means of Digital Communication
full_name: New York S 6278 — Aggravated Harassment by Means of Digital Communication
summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment by means of electronic or digital communication, provides for a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination or publication of deep fakes, which are digitized images which are altered to incorporate a person's face or their identifiable body part onto an image and such image depicts a pornographic or lewd sex act or graphic violence.

short_name: New York A 6293 — Crime of Aggravated Harassment
full_name: New York A 6293 — Crime of Aggravated Harassment
summary: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment by means of electronic or digital communication, provides for a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination or publication of deep fakes, which are digitized images which are altered to incorporate a person's face or their identifiable body part onto an image and such image depicts a pornographic or lewd sex act or graphic violence.

short_name: New York S 6301 — Commission to Study and Regulate AI and Robotics
full_name: New York S 6301 — Commission to Study and Regulate AI and Robotics
summary: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation, repeals such commission.

short_name: New York A 6453 — Responsible AI Safety and Education Act
full_name: New York A 6453 — Responsible AI Safety and Education Act
summary: Relates to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models, provides that, before deploying a frontier model, the large developer of such model shall, among other things, implement a written safety and security protocol, grant the Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Services or the Attorney General access to the safety and security protocol, and implement appropriate safeguards to prevent unreasonable risk of critical harm, provides for civil actions and penalties for violations.

short_name: New York S 6471 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Landlords
full_name: New York S 6471 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Landlords
summary: Relates to the use of automated decision tools by landlords for making housing decisions, sets conditions and rules for use of such tools.

short_name: New York A 6491 — Creation and Dissemination of Synthetic Media
full_name: New York A 6491 — Creation and Dissemination of Synthetic Media
summary: Prohibits the creation and dissemination of synthetic media within a specified number of days of an election with intent to unduly influence the outcome of an election, makes such act a class E felony.

short_name: New York A 6540 — Generative Artificial Intelligence Providers
full_name: New York A 6540 — Generative Artificial Intelligence Providers
summary: Requiring synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that the synthetic content creations system provider makes available.

short_name: New York A 6545 — Liability for Damages Caused by Chatbot
full_name: New York A 6545 — Liability for Damages Caused by Chatbot
summary: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating licensed professionals or giving any medical or psychological advice.

short_name: New York A 6578 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
full_name: New York A 6578 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

short_name: New York S 6748 — Publications Using Artificial Intelligence
full_name: New York S 6748 — Publications Using Artificial Intelligence
summary: Requires that every newspaper, magazine or other publication printed or electronically published in this state, which contains the use of generative artificial intelligence or other information communication technology, shall identify that certain parts of such newspaper, magazine, or publication were composed through the use of artificial intelligence or other information communication technology.

short_name: New York S 6751 — Empire State Film Production Credit
full_name: New York S 6751 — Empire State Film Production Credit
summary: Excludes a production using artificial intelligence or autonomous vehicles in a manner which results in the displacement of employees whose salaries are qualified expenses from the definition of qualified film for the purposes of the empire state film production credit.

short_name: New York A 6765 — Algorithmic Pricing
full_name: New York A 6765 — Algorithmic Pricing
summary: Relates to algorithmic pricing, defines terms.

short_name: New York A 6767 — Provision of an Artificial Intelligence Companion
full_name: New York A 6767 — Provision of an Artificial Intelligence Companion
summary: Prohibits the provision of an artificial intelligence companion to a user unless such artificial intelligence companion contains a protocol for addressing possible suicidal ideation or self-harm expressed by a user, possible physical harm to others expressed by a user, and possible financial harm to others expressed by a user, requires certain notifications to certain users regarding crisis service providers and the non-human nature of such companion models.

short_name: New York A 6874 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act
full_name: New York A 6874 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act
summary: Establishes the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act which establishes an artificial intelligence literacy in the digital equity competitive grant program.

short_name: New York S 6953 — Use of Artificial Intelligence Frontier Models
full_name: New York S 6953 — Use of Artificial Intelligence Frontier Models
summary: Relates to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models, defines terms, establishes remedies for violations.

short_name: New York S 6954 — Stop Deepfakes Act
full_name: New York S 6954 — Stop Deepfakes Act
summary: Requires synthetic content creations system provider to apply provenance data, either directly or through the use of third-party technology, to synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that the synthetic content creations system provider makes available.

short_name: New York S 6955 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
full_name: New York S 6955 — Artificial Intelligence Training Data Transparency Act
summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act, requires developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information, regards the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, includes a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

short_name: New York A 6972 — Artificial Intelligence Working Group
full_name: New York A 6972 — Artificial Intelligence Working Group
summary: Creates an artificial intelligence working group within the department of education for the purpose of developing guidance and a model policy on the safe and effective use of artificial intelligence in ways that benefit, and do not harm, pupils and educators.

short_name: New York A 6974 — Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation for All Act
full_name: New York A 6974 — Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation for All Act
summary: Enacts the Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation for All Act, requires a setting which allows a social media user to turn off algorithmic recommendations and other notifications, prohibits the use of dark patterns to subvert choice or inhibit users from accessing certain mechanisms.

short_name: New York A 7029 — Commissioner of Education
full_name: New York A 7029 — Commissioner of Education
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to make recommendations to the board of regents regarding the incorporation of instruction in artificial intelligence system literacy into the school curriculum at the elementary, junior high and senior high levela, directs the board of regents to adopt guidelines if the curriculum is adopted.

short_name: New York S 7033 — Algorithmic Pricing Discrimination Act
full_name: New York S 7033 — Algorithmic Pricing Discrimination Act
summary: Enacts the preventing algorithmic pricing discrimination act, requires the disclosure of algorithmically set prices.

short_name: New York A 7172 — Division of Criminal Justice Services
full_name: New York A 7172 — Division of Criminal Justice Services
summary: Requires the division of criminal justice services to formulate a protocol for the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations, restricts the use of artificial intelligence-generated outputs in court.

short_name: New York S 7202 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
full_name: New York S 7202 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
summary: Establishes crimes for the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, amends the criminal procedure law, in relation to the statute of limitations for commencing cases related to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, repeals section 245.15 of the penal law relating to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_name: New York S 7263 — Liability for Damages Caused By a Chatbot
full_name: New York S 7263 — Liability for Damages Caused By a Chatbot
summary: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals.

short_name: New York A 7278 — State Agencies and State Owned Entities
full_name: New York A 7278 — State Agencies and State Owned Entities
summary: Prohibits state agencies and state-owned entities from utilizing large language models or any artificial intelligence systems to make decisions that affect individuals' rights, benefits, or services, requires such decisions to be made by human personnel of the respective state agency or state-owned entity, provides exceptions, provides for enforcement.

short_name: New York A 7305 — Penalties for Insurance Fraud
full_name: New York A 7305 — Penalties for Insurance Fraud
summary: Relates to increasing penalties for insurance fraud, mandating investigations, and enhancing accountability for state agencies and offices responsible for insurance fraud prevention.

short_name: New York S 7599 — Automated Decision-Making by Government Agencies
full_name: New York S 7599 — Automated Decision-Making by Government Agencies
summary: Amends the state technology law, the education law and the civil service law, in relation to automated decision-making by government agencies.

short_name: New York A 7611 — State Digital Government Modernization Act
full_name: New York A 7611 — State Digital Government Modernization Act
summary: Enacts the State Digital Government Modernization Act, establishes the digital government modernization initiative and the digital government enhancements pilot program.

short_name: New York A 7656 — Political Communication Created With Generative AI
full_name: New York A 7656 — Political Communication Created With Generative AI
summary: Prohibits political communication containing any photo, video or audio depiction of a candidate created in whole or in part through the use of generative artificial intelligence.

short_name: New York S 7691 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act
full_name: New York S 7691 — Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act
summary: Establishes the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Act which establishes an artificial intelligence literacy in the digital equity competitive grant program.

short_name: New York A 7855 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
full_name: New York A 7855 — Unlawful Dissemination or Publication of Intimate Image
summary: Relates to establishing crimes for the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, amends the criminal procedure law, in relation to the statute of limitations for commencing cases related to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image, repeals section 245.15 of the penal law relating to the unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

short_name: New York S 7882 — Residential Rental Dwelling Units
full_name: New York S 7882 — Residential Rental Dwelling Units
summary: Prohibits a person or entity from knowingly or with reckless disregard facilitate an agreement between or among two or more residential rental property owners or managers to not compete with respect to residential rental dwelling units, including by operating or licensing a software, data analytics service, or algorithmic device that performs a coordinating function on behalf of or between and among such residential rental property owners or managers.

short_name: New York S 7892 — Commissioner of Education
full_name: New York S 7892 — Commissioner of Education
summary: Directs the commissioner of education to make recommendations to the board of regents regarding the incorporation of instruction in artificial intelligence system literacy into the school curriculum for junior and senior high schools, directs the board of regents to adopt guidelines if the curriculum is adopted.

short_name: New York S 7896 — Requirements for Use of an Artificial Intelligence Tool
full_name: New York S 7896 — Requirements for Use of an Artificial Intelligence Tool
summary: Prescribes requirements and safeguards for the use of an artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tool for the purpose of utilization review for health and accident insurance.

short_name: New York S 7963 — Political Communications
full_name: New York S 7963 — Political Communications
summary: Requires certain political communications to include provenance data for all audios, images or videos used in such communications, provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

short_name: New York A 8022 — Operator of a Covered Platform
full_name: New York A 8022 — Operator of a Covered Platform
summary: Requires an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users to ensure that its covered platform provides a process to allow law enforcement agencies to contact such covered platform, which shall include making available a staffed hotline for the purposes of receiving and responding to questions about search warrants, acknowledging receipt of search warrants, provides status updates on warrant compliance, and which shall provide continuous availability of such process.

short_name: New York S 8115 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Banks
full_name: New York S 8115 — Use of Automated Decision Tools by Banks
summary: Relates to the use of automated decision tools by banks for the purposes of making lending decisions.

short_name: New York S 8202 — Computer Science Course Requirement for High School
full_name: New York S 8202 — Computer Science Course Requirement for High School
summary: Creates a computer science course requirement for graduation from high school, directs the department of education to design and implement such program.

short_name: New York S 8217 — Law Enforcement Agencies Staffed Hotline
full_name: New York S 8217 — Law Enforcement Agencies Staffed Hotline
summary: Relates to requiring certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours.

short_name: New York A 8295 — Automated Decision Making by Government Agencies
full_name: New York A 8295 — Automated Decision Making by Government Agencies
summary: Provides that any State agency that utilizes an automated decision making tool shall publish a list of such automated decision making tools on such State agency's website, provides that such disclosure shall include, among other things, a description of the automated decision making tool utilized by such State agency, requires agencies to conduct impact assessments, provides that the Office of Information Technology Services shall maintain an inventory of State automated decision making tools.

short_name: New York S 8331 — Artificial Intelligence Transparency for Journalism Act
full_name: New York S 8331 — Artificial Intelligence Transparency for Journalism Act
summary: Requires transparency from generative artificial intelligence developers for journalism providers.

short_name: New York S 8356 — State Opportunity Promise Scholarship
full_name: New York S 8356 — State Opportunity Promise Scholarship
summary: Expands the State opportunity promise scholarship to include all SUNY and CUNY approved programs which award certain associate's degrees.

short_name: New York A 8449 — Prohibition on Sexually Explicit Depictions of Children

Platform must detect irregularities, optimize administration, and provide public access to information. Requires coordination with Inspector General, General Services Administration, and Office of Government Ethics. PRITS must submit annual report to Legislature by June 30 each year.
key_obligations: PRITS must develop and implement AI platform for real-time monitoring of all government public auctions
Platform must detect irregularities and ensure administrative optimization
Public access to auction information must be ensured
Platform must comply with cybersecurity and personal data protection standards
PRITS must coordinate with Inspector General, GSA, and Office of Government Ethics
PRITS must include detailed summary on AI platform in annual legislative report (due June 30)
notes: Introduced April 23, 2026 by Mr. Reyes Berríos. Amends Art. 6(f) of Act 75-2019.

full_name: Virginia H 310 — Artificial Intelligence Workforce Impact Act

full_name: Virginia S 429 — Nursing Home Oversight and Accountability

full_name: Virginia S 500 — Health Insurance

full_name: Virginia H 669 — Chatbot Impersonation of Licensed Professionals

full_name: Virginia H 758 — Artificial Intelligence Chatbots and Minors Act

full_name: Virginia H 1250 — Technology Governance and Coordination Program

short_name: Virginia H 1252 — State Residential Landlord and Tenant Act
full_name: Virginia H 1252 — State Residential Landlord and Tenant Act

short_name: Virginia H 1257 — Law Enforcement Agencies
full_name: Virginia H 1257 — Law Enforcement Agencies

short_name: Virginia H 1261 — Law Enforcement Agencies
full_name: Virginia H 1261 — Law Enforcement Agencies

full_name: Virginia H 1294 — Artificial Intelligence Based Tools

short_name: Virginia H 1295 — Law Enforcement
full_name: Virginia H 1295 — Law Enforcement

short_name: Virginia H 1451 — Labor and Employment
full_name: Virginia H 1451 — Labor and Employment
