short_name: Virginia H 1514 — Employment Decisions
full_name: Virginia H 1514 — Employment Decisions
summary: Relates to employment decisions, relates to automated decision systems, relates to civil penalty, provides that the Director of the Department of Human Resource Management shall require any state agency that uses an automated decision system as a substantial factor in any employment decision, as those terms are defined in the bill, to ensure that such system and the use of such system complies with federal and state law, make certain disclosures, provide an opt-out mechanism, annually test such system.

short_name: Virginia H 1521 — Digital Innovation and Infrastructure
full_name: Virginia H 1521 — Digital Innovation and Infrastructure

short_name: Virginia H 249 — Department of Criminal Justice Services
full_name: Virginia H 249 — Department of Criminal Justice Services

short_name: Virginia H 250 — Department of Criminal Justice Services

full_name: Virginia S 385 — Artificial Intelligence Technology In Education Study

full_name: Virginia S 571 — Synthetic Media
summary: Relates to synthetic media, relates to penalty, expands the applicability of provisions related to defamation, slander, and libel to include synthetic media, defined in the bill, makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person to generate, create, or use or cause to be generated, created, or used any deceptive audio or visual media, defined in the bill, for the purpose of committing a criminal offense involving fraud.

short_name: Virginia H 697 — Synthetic Media

summary: Relates to synthetic media, relates to penalty, expands the applicability of provisions related to defamation, slander, and libel to include synthetic media, defined in the bill, makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person to generate, create, or use or cause to be generated, created, or used any deceptive audio or visual media, defined in the bill, for the purpose of committing a criminal offense involving fraud, creates a rebuttable presumption that such deceptive audio or visual media was generated.

short_name: Virginia S 731 — Child Pornography Financing
full_name: Virginia S 731 — Child Pornography Financing

short_name: Virginia H 747 — Artificial Intelligence Developer Act
full_name: Virginia H 747 — Artificial Intelligence Developer Act
summary: Relates to artificial Intelligence Developer Act established, relates to civil penalty, creates operating standards for developers and deployers, as those terms are defined in the bill, relating to artificial intelligence, including avoiding certain risks, protecting against discrimination, providing disclosures, and conducting impact assessments and provides that the Office of the Attorney General shall enforce the provisions of the bill.

short_name: Virginia S 775 — Political Campaign Advertisements
full_name: Virginia S 775 — Political Campaign Advertisements
summary: Relates to elections, relates to election offenses, defines synthetic media as images or audio recordings of real events relating to an identifiable individual that have been intentionally altered in a manner that would cause a reasonable person to mistakenly believe that the manipulated image or audio is a recording of a real event and to have a fundamentally different understanding or impression of the expressive content of the image or audio than that person would have.

short_name: Virginia H 1051 — Public Education

full_name: Virginia S 1161 — Artificial Intelligence Transparency Act

short_name: Virginia S 1214 — High Risk Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Virginia S 1214 — High Risk Artificial Intelligence
summary: Relates to high-risk artificial intelligence, relates to development, deployment, and use by public bodies, relates to work group, relates to report, creates requirements for the development, deployment, and use of high-risk artificial intelligence systems by state public bodies, directs the Chief Information Officer of the Commonwealth to develop, publish, and maintain policies and procedures concerning the development, procurement, implementation, and utilization.

full_name: Virginia S 1400 — Residential Landlord and Tenant Act

full_name: Virginia S 1417 — Digital Content Authenticity and Transparency Act

full_name: Virginia H 2046 — High Risk Artificial Intelligence

full_name: Virginia H 2047 — State Residential Landlord and Tenant Act

short_name: Virginia H 2094 — High Risk Artificial Intelligence
full_name: Virginia H 2094 — High Risk Artificial Intelligence
